**What Makes Us a Great Place To Work**
We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work, a champion of diversity and a model of social responsibility. We are currently ranked the #1 consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list, and we have maintained a spot in the top four on Glassdoor's list for the last 12 years. We believe that diversity, inclusion and collaboration is key to building extraordinary teams. We hire people with exceptional talents, abilities and potential, then create an environment where you can become the best version of yourself and thrive both professionally and personally. We are publicly recognized by external parties such as Fortune, Vault, Mogul, Working Mother, Glassdoor and the Human Rights Campaign for being a great place to work for diversity and inclusion, women, LGBTQ and parents..

title: Head of Commercialization and Operations, New Approach Methodologies (NAMs)
description:
**Head of Commercialization and Operations, New Approach Methodologies (NAMs)**

**Location:**

New Delhi, India

**Employment Type:**

Full time

**Reports to:**

Founders and Board

**About NITS Engineering**

NITS Engineering is a biomedical technology company building the next generation of biomedical devices, in vitro disease models, and engineering systems for drug discovery, regenerative medicine, and diagnostics. We combine precision hardware engineering with biomedical research to build the tools that take science from the lab bench to real world application.

**Role Overview**

Regulators worldwide are reducing reliance on animal testing, and drug developers need human relevant models they trust. We are building high throughput bioprinted human tissue platforms, starting with engineered cardiac tissue, for safety assessment, disease modeling, and drug discovery.

We are seeking a commercial and operational leader who has taken NAMs to market. You will own the path from validated science to revenue: defining products and pricing, winning pilots and first contracts with pharma, biotech, and CROs, shaping the validation evidence customers require, and building the operations that deliver reliably at scale. This work is carried out in collaboration with CenFab, the Center for Biofabrication at Vellore Institute of Technology, Vellore.

**What You Will Do**

**Go to Market and Revenue**

* Define product offerings, target customer segments, and the business model (assay services, kits, or platform licensing).
* Set pricing for pilot studies, service contracts, and platform access.
* Build and manage the pipeline: lead pilot evaluations, convert them into paid contracts, and establish recurring revenue.
* Secure partnerships with pharma, biotech, CROs, distributors, and academic centers in India, the US, and Europe.
* Deliver the first commercial milestones: paid pilots in year one and recurring contracts by year two.

**Validation That Drives Adoption**

* Work with the R&D team to design validation studies that answer the questions buyers and regulators ask, including reference compound sets, sensitivity, specificity, and reproducibility.
* Benchmark our models against human clinical data, animal data, and incumbent in vitro assays to build a clear value case.
* Align the evidence package with FDA, EMA, CDSCO, and OECD expectations, and decide when to pursue formal qualification routes.
* Translate customer feedback into product requirements and specifications.

**Operations and Quality**

* Build the quality management system for commercial model production, including SOPs, batch release criteria, and documentation suitable for customer audits.
* Establish supply chain and vendor management for cells, reagents, and consumables, including import planning.
* Set up service delivery workflows, timelines, and data reporting standards for customer projects.
* Scale capacity in step with demand while maintaining batch to batch consistency.

**Leadership and External Engagement**

* Lead business development, project management, and operations staff, working closely with scientific teams.
* Represent NITS Engineering at industry conferences, NAM consortia, and investor meetings.
* Prepare commercial proposals, study designs, white papers, and pitch materials.
* Support fundraising and nondilutive grant applications with market and commercial strategy.

**What We Are Looking For**

* At least 8 years of professional experience, with at least 4 years commercializing NAMs, in vitro models, or preclinical services in industry.
* A proven record of selling NAM products or services to pharma, biotech, or CROs, with demonstrable contract values and customer relationships.
* Experience setting pricing, running pilot to contract conversion, and negotiating commercial agreements.
* Hands-on experience building operations or quality systems (ISO 9001, ISO 13485, or GLP) for an assay, model, or product.
* Working knowledge of at least one NAM domain: microphysiological systems, organoids, 3D tissue models, iPSC derived assays, or in silico safety tools.
* A scientific degree in a relevant discipline. A PhD, MBA, or both is valued but not required.
* Strong network across pharma safety and discovery teams, CROs, and the NAM community.

**Nice to Have**

* Contributions to regulatory or validation initiatives with FDA, EMA, NIH/NICEATM, EURL ECVAM, OECD, or CDSCO.
* Experience commercializing 3D bioprinted or cardiac models.
* Experience managing multilab reproducibility studies or technology transfer to customer sites.
* Experience at a startup or early stage company through first revenue or fundraising.

**Why Join**

* Lead the commercial launch of human relevant NAM platforms from first customer to scale.
* Shape a company at an early stage, with direct influence on strategy, products, and growth.
* Work alongside biomedical engineers and cell biologists in a multidisciplinary environment, with access to the CenFab biofabrication hub.
* Help modernize preclinical testing and reduce reliance on animal studies.

title: Strategic Account Manager – North India (Enterprise & Mid-Market Customers)
description:
**Company Description**
**Arista Networks**
is an industry leader in data-driven, client-to-cloud networking for large data center, campus and routing environments. Arista is a well-established and profitable company with over $8 billion in revenue. Arista’s award-winning platforms, ranging in Ethernet speeds up to 800G bits per second, redefine scalability, agility, and resilience. Arista is a founding member of the Ultra Ethernet consortium. We have shipped over 20 million cloud networking ports worldwide with CloudVision and EOS, an advanced network operating system. Arista is committed to open standards, and its products are available worldwide directly and through partners.
  
  
At Arista, we value the diversity of thought and perspectives each employee brings. We believe fostering an inclusive environment where individuals from various backgrounds and experiences feel welcome is essential for driving creativity and innovation.
  
  
Our commitment to excellence has earned us several prestigious awards, such as the Great Place to Work Survey for Best Engineering Team and Best Company for Diversity, Compensation, and Work-Life Balance. At Arista, we take pride in our track record of success and strive to maintain the highest quality and performance standards in everything we do.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Who You’ll Work With:**
You will work for
**Arista Networks**
, a global leader in data-driven networking solutions, as a
**Strategic Account Manager**
responsible for driving revenue growth across enterprise and mid-market accounts in North India. In this role, you’ll lead end-to-end sales cycles, develop new strategic accounts, and expand existing relationships by promoting Arista’s full portfolio of innovative networking, cloud, and security solutions. Collaborating closely with system engineers, channel partners, and executive leadership, you will play a critical role in delivering high-impact customer outcomes and contributing to Arista’s continued success in the region.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
Arista Networks is looking for a highly driven
**Strategic Account Manager**
to lead and grow our business across
**enterprise and mid-market accounts**
in
**North India**
. This is a critical field-facing role focused on acquiring new logos and expanding wallet share in existing accounts.
  
  
The ideal candidate will have a
**hunter mindset**
with a proven track record of selling networking, cloud, or security infrastructure solutions to CXOs and IT leaders. You will partner closely with system engineers, channel teams, marketing, and leadership to deliver superior customer outcomes.
  
  
**Refined For Clarity And Conciseness**

* Own and exceed revenue targets across named enterprise and mid-market accounts in North India
* Identify, engage, and develop new strategic accounts (white space)
* Drive full sales cycles from prospecting to close using a consultative, value-based approach
* Sell the entire Arista portfolio:

+ Data Center Switching (Leaf/Spine)
+ Cloud Grade Routing
+ Cognitive Campus (incl. WiFi)
+ NDR/Security (Awake)
+ CloudVision (Automation & Telemetry)
+ Monitoring Fabric (Big Switch)

* Leverage Arista SEs and channel partners to build solution proposals aligned to customer IT and business outcomes
* Engage with C-level and VP-level executives to understand their IT transformation journey and position Arista’s strategic value
* Conduct Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and maintain detailed account plans
* Collaborate on local demand generation campaigns, technology briefings, and workshops
* Contribute to accurate pipeline and forecast management
* Stay updated on competitor positioning, pricing strategies, and industry shifts

**Qualifications**

* 12+ years of technology sales experience, including managing strategic enterprise accounts
* Deep experience in networking, cloud infrastructure, or cybersecurity (Arista domain exposure is a plus)
* Demonstrated success in acquiring new logos and expanding within existing enterprise clients
* Ability to sell to CXO and senior decision-makers
* Strong communication and executive presence
* Proven account planning, pipeline discipline, and accurate forecasting
* Channel ecosystem understanding and experience with a partner-led GTM
* BS in Engineering/Technology or equivalent; MBA is a plus

**Additional Information**
Arista stands out as an engineering-centric company. Our leadership, including founders and engineering managers, are all engineers who understand sound software engineering principles and the importance of doing things right.
  
  
We hire globally into our diverse team. At Arista, engineers have complete ownership of their projects. Our management structure is flat and streamlined, and software engineering is led by those who understand it best. We prioritize the development and utilization of test automation tools.
  
  
Our engineers have access to every part of the company, providing opportunities to work across various domains. Arista is headquartered in Santa Clara, California, with development offices in Australia, Canada, India, Ireland, and the US. We consider all our R&D centers equal in stature.
  
  
Join us to shape the future of networking and be part of a culture that values invention, quality, respect, and fun.

* Excellent supplier management and relationship building ability - strong supplier-facing skill with the aptitude and awareness to bring a high degree of value from the relationship in terms of cost control, working practices and supplier performance.
* Results driven - demonstrating a sense of urgency; persisting in the face of obstacles; putting top priority on getting results.

* Influencing and Negotiating - winning support from others; shaping the opinions of key stakeholders within A&O and our suppliers; working through conflict to create a win/win result.
* Sound working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite

* Highly effective written and oral communicator to all levels within an organisation. Ability to tailor approach to audience requirements.
* Transition Solutions
* Experience of: IT outsourcing, Desktop and other hardware Deployment, Service Transition, Global audits

* International experience in delivering projects across multiple countries through multiple partners.
* Consultative approach
* Personable relationship builder
* Strategic thinker with good analytical ability
* Proven ability to manage external relationships successfully - customer, supplier, partner relationships
* Effective stakeholder management
* External market understanding and implications for product set.
* Ability to demonstrate successful influence over business process without hierarchical authority
* Experience of successfully working in a complex matrix environment

A&O IT Group
  
  
As a successful and growing global IT services provider, A&O IT Group deliver ‘fully managed’ IT solutions and cyber security services. title: Assistant Manager, Dedicated Managed Services
description:
Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 6,000+ employees and 34,000+ customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500. Founded in 1999, Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people together at events around the world. In short, we’re transforming the meetings and events industry through innovative technology that powers human connection.
  
  
Headquartered in Tysons Corner, Virginia, Cvent (formerly NYSE: CVT) was acquired by Blackstone and Vista for $4.6B in 2023.
  
  
Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections.
  
  
Cvent is redefining the meetings and events industry through technology that advances human connection
*.*
**AI at Cvent: Leading the Future**
Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI-augmented work, you’ll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation.

**#Leadership & People Management**

title: Manager - Tax-TTC- AMS- Hyderabad/Bengaluru/Gurugram/Pune/Mumbai
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Manager - AMS - CLM**
The need for ongoing support and optimization of legal technology solutions is more critical than ever, empowering legal departments to maximize the value of their investments and ensure continuous improvement in service delivery. If you are passionate about enabling legal transformation through proactive application management and enjoy collaborating with dedicated professionals to help organizations achieve operational excellence, we invite you to join our team. Apply now!
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
Our Legal Business Services Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) practice is expanding its Application Managed Services team (AMS). As a CLM AMS Portfolio lead/Manager within the Application Managed Services (AMS) Team, you will manage multiple AMS projects within the CLM practice, ensuring client requirements are met and service levels are consistently maintained or exceeded. you will play a pivotal role in leading teams to deliver high-quality support, drive continuous improvement, and ensure the success of our clients’ business-critical applications throughout their transformation journey.
  
  
You will oversee and mentor cross-functional teams, coordinate with internal stakeholders, and foster strategic client relationships to deliver exceptional service. Your responsibilities include managing escalations, overseeing client communications, ensuring adherence to SLAs, and identifying opportunities for innovation and process optimization at scale. This role requires strong leadership, strategic thinking, and client management skills, along with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  
  
As a CLM AMS Portfolio Lead/Manager, you will contribute to the growth and success of Deloitte Tax LLP in a variety of way, including:
  
  
**Client Management**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for key client stakeholders, building trusted advisor relationships and ensuring client satisfaction.
* Prepare and present regular status reports to clients and internal stakeholders.
* Work closely with customers to answer questions about the features and capabilities of our product.
* Ensure proactive communication of upgrade plans and coordinate with clients and internal teams to minimize business disruption.

**Delivery**

* Lead and manage a team providing day-to-day support for CLM applications, including incident management, troubleshooting, and resolution of technical and functional issues of multiple AMS projects or PODs.
* Ensure compliance with SLAs, KPIs, and contractual obligations.
* Oversee the resolution of complex or escalated issues, providing guidance and direction to team members.
* Assist in the development and execution of test plans for system changes, enhancements, and new releases. Oversee quality assurance and ensure best practices are followed.

**Solutions**

* Design, configure, and implement changes or upgrades to CLM platforms (e.g., Icertis, Conga, DocuSign CLM, Agiloft), ensuring alignment with client requirements and best practices.
* Specialize in resolving issues pertaining to customer-specific configuration and third-party integration. Guide the team in providing innovative solutions and workarounds.
* Collaborate with clients and internal leadership to understand business objectives and translate them into system strategies, configurations, or enhancements.
* Stay current on CLM technology trends and best practices to provide innovative solutions to clients. Share insights and best practices with both clients and internal teams.

**Support**

* Document processes, configurations, and solutions to ensure knowledge transfer and continuity. Establish and maintain documentation standards across the team.
* Support user training and adoption activities, including the creation of user guides and training materials. Drive change management and adoption strategies for clients.
* Support resource planning, onboarding, and training for project teams.

**Project Management**

* Participate in continuous improvement initiatives to optimize CLM processes and system performance. Lead process improvement projects and champion innovation within the team.

**Cross Functional Teaming**

* Collaborate with clients and internal leadership to understand business objectives and translate them into system strategies, configurations, or enhancements.

**People Development**

* Support resource planning, onboarding, and training for project teams.
* Oversee the resolution of complex or escalated issues, providing guidance and direction to team members.

**Business Development**

* Contribute to business development efforts, including proposal development, client presentations, and identifying opportunities for expanding AMS services.

**The team**
At Deloitte Tax LLP, our Legal Business Services group within the Tax Technology Consulting (TTC) practice helps legal departments pursue a streamlined, transparent, and efficient legal function that enhances the core responsibilities of operations, contracting, compliance, reporting and planning, while also positioning Deloitte as a strategic business advisor for the digital era. We specialize in advising legal departments and can effectively address a corporate legal function’s unique needs, requirements and obligations. As legal operations and contracting specialists, we help clients make appropriate operations and technology choices. Our team, the largest of its type, offers the necessary combination of skills, methodology and practical experience to help clients with contract lifecycle management, legal entity management, and legal operations services.
  
  
Deloitte TTC-LBS professionals are aligned across our global network of member firms to support our clients’ objectives and address their challenges. Our team’s multi-disciplinary approach combines technical and technology skillsets, enabling greater impact and efficiency within our client’s organization. TTC’s Legal Business Services team helps clients with operating model evaluation, roadmap development for a desired future state, data management solutions, automation opportunities, contract lifecycle management, legal entity management, and legal operating models. Learn more about Deloitte Legal Business Services.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Required:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, or related field.
* 6+ years of experience in CLM System configuration, application management, system support, or technology consulting, with CLM platforms (e.g., Icertis, Conga, DocuSign CLM, Agiloft, etc.).
* Trained and certified on DocuSign/Icertis/Sirion Platform (Ex. Certified DocuSign CLM Administrator, Certified DocuSign CLM Workflow Developer, Certified DocuSign CLM Implementation Consultant, . Icertis certified ICI Administrator, Icertis Certified Functional Professional, Sirion Certified CLM Specialist)
* 3+ years of experience in leadership or managerial role, overseeing teams and client engagements.
* Proven track record in solving problems from a technical and business perspective.
* Deep understanding of customer support processes and CRM/SaaS platforms. Ability to follow defined processes.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot technical and functional issues. Ability to provide innovative workarounds or design a solution to fix a customer’s problem.
* Ability to coordinate, follow up, follow through and drive issues to closure proactively.
* Familiarity with contract management processes and terminology.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple client relationships and lead cross-functional teams.
* Strong project management skills and experience with resource planning and team development.
* Willingness to work in shifts and travel on demand.

**Preferred:**

* Experience supporting legal teams or procurement teams with contract management
* Experience in working large-scale AMS or CLM projects and process improvement initiatives.
* Experience in business development, proposal writing, or pre-sales support.
* Experience in Customer Support or professional services in client-facing environment.
* Project management certification (e.g., PMP, Agile) or process improvement experience (e.g., Lean, Six Sigma), IT service management (e.g. ITIL)

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.
  
  
Information for applicants with a need for accommodation: https://www2.deloitte.com/us/en/pages/careers/articles/join-deloitte-assistance-for-disabled-applicants.html
  
  
**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
  
  
**Recruiting tips**
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

title: Greenfield Account Lead
description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.
  
  
**A Day in the Life**
The Strategic Key Accounts team is responsible for developing and expanding relationships with large, complex healthcare organizations and strategic customers. This function partners across commercial, marketing, and business unit teams to align account strategies with customer priorities, identify growth opportunities, and support long-term business partnerships. The role focuses on portfolio growth, market share expansion, strategic account planning, and value-based customer engagement.
  
  
This position is based in Gurgaon, India and operates in a remote work environment. The role requires approximately 30% travel to customer sites, internal meetings, and key stakeholder engagements across the assigned territory.
  
  
The Greenfield Account Lead is responsible for managing strategic healthcare accounts, building executive-level customer relationships, and driving business growth through account planning, portfolio expansion, and commercial execution. This role collaborates with internal stakeholders and customer leadership teams to identify opportunities, develop account-specific strategies, and support achievement of business objectives across assigned accounts.
  
  
Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned.
  
  

* Develop and maintain relationships with senior executives and key decision-makers within strategic healthcare accounts.
* Create and execute account plans aligned with customer priorities, business objectives, and growth targets.
* Identify, qualify, and advance new business opportunities within assigned strategic accounts.
* Collaborate with business units, marketing, and cross-functional teams to implement account strategies and customer programs.
* Analyze customer needs, market dynamics, and competitive activity to recommend solutions that support account growth.
* Negotiate and support long-term contractual agreements that strengthen customer relationships and expand portfolio adoption.
* Monitor account performance, sales results, and opportunity pipelines to achieve revenue and market share objectives.
* Provide customer and market insights to support strategic planning, pricing discussions, and business decision-making.

**Required Qualifications**

* High School Diploma (or equivalent) AND 10+ years’ experience\* OR Associate’s Degree AND 8+ years’ experience\* OR Bachelor’s Degree AND 6+ years’ experience. Experience managing strategic or enterprise-level customer accounts with responsibility for revenue growth and relationship management.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working within the medical device, healthcare technology, life sciences, or healthcare services industry. Demonstrated success leading complex negotiations and supporting contractual business agreements.
* Experience collaborating across multiple business units and cross-functional teams to deliver customer solutions. Knowledge of healthcare market trends, hospital operations, and strategic account management methodologies.

title: Account Manager- Influencer Mraketing
description:
Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced and driven
**Account Manager – Influencer Marketing**
to lead our Operations team and oversee the execution of multiple influencer marketing campaigns across brands.

This is a team leadership role that involves managing Team Leads (TLs) who are responsible for campaign execution, ensuring seamless coordination between internal teams, maintaining high standards of client delivery, and driving operational efficiency across accounts.

The ideal candidate should have strong experience in influencer marketing campaign execution, team management, client servicing, and stakeholder coordination. They should be comfortable managing multiple brands simultaneously, handling escalations, improving execution processes, and ensuring that campaigns are delivered within defined timelines and quality standards.

Key Responsibilities (KRAs)

**1. Team Leadership & Performance Management**

* Lead, mentor, and manage a team of Team Leads responsible for executing influencer marketing campaigns across multiple brands.
* Establish clear goals, ownership, and performance expectations for Team Leads and their respective teams.
* Monitor team productivity, campaign progress, workload distribution, and overall execution quality.
* Conduct regular performance reviews, provide constructive feedback, and identify development opportunities for team members.
* Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, proactive problem-solving, and ownership within the Operations team.

**2. Campaign Execution & Delivery**

* Oversee the end-to-end execution of multiple influencer marketing campaigns, from the handover of locked creators by the Procurement team to final campaign closure.
* Ensure that campaign briefs, deliverables, timelines, budgets, and brand guidelines are clearly communicated to the execution teams.
* Monitor campaign milestones, including creator onboarding, briefing, content coordination, approvals, posting schedules, live links, and performance reporting.
* Ensure campaigns are executed on time and meet the agreed quality standards and client expectations.
* Proactively identify execution bottlenecks, resolve operational challenges, and ensure timely delivery across all active accounts.

**3. Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Work closely with the Planning, Procurement, Strategy, Creative, and Revenue teams to ensure smooth campaign handovers and execution.
* Ensure the Operations team receives complete campaign information, including creator details, commercials, deliverables, timelines, and client-specific requirements.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders to resolve dependencies and minimise delays during campaign execution.
* Establish clear communication channels and escalation processes across departments.
* Ensure seamless collaboration between teams while maintaining clarity on responsibilities, timelines, and deliverables.

**4. Client Delivery & Escalation Management**

* Take ownership of campaign delivery across assigned brands and ensure that client commitments are met.
* Work closely with Revenue and Brand Management teams to address client concerns, execution challenges, and urgent requirements.
* Handle escalations related to campaign delays, creator dropouts, content approvals, missed deliverables, and other operational issues.
* Ensure that potential risks are identified and communicated proactively, along with clear action plans and solutions.
* Maintain high standards of execution, responsiveness, and professionalism across all brand accounts.

**5. Operational Excellence & Process Improvement**

* Develop and improve workflows, SOPs, reporting mechanisms, and campaign tracking systems to enhance operational efficiency.
* Monitor key operational metrics such as campaign turnaround time, on-time delivery, execution accuracy, team productivity, and escalation frequency.
* Identify recurring challenges and implement corrective measures to reduce errors, delays, and unnecessary rework.
* Ensure accurate documentation of campaign status, deliverables, creator commitments, approvals, and closures.
* Drive process standardisation across teams while adapting execution workflows to individual brand requirements.

title: Assistant Manager – NRI Operations (KYC & Onboarding)
description:
**Team Lead/ Assistant Manager**
– NRI Operations (KYC & Onboarding)

You’ll lead our NRI KYC & Onboarding team — operations relationship managers who help NRI users complete, fix and update their KYC across calls, chats and emails. Resolve all kinds of customer pain points including rejected documents and Aadhaar/Passport mismatches to Video KYC failures, overseas address proof issues and NRE/NRO/Foreign National account queries, your team makes sure no NRI customer stays stuck, regardless of time zone.

You’ll own the key responsibilities - Onboarding conversion, CSAT, team’s performance, coach your people hands-on, and work with cross-product operations team, product team and compliance to fix problems at the root.

**What you’ll do**

* Lead, coach and grow a multi-channel team of NRI KYC operations executives

* Manage team rosters and real-time queues to handle peak onboarding volumes and overseas customer hours
* Personally resolve complex and escalated KYC and NRI account cases (NRE/NRO/Foreign National, RI-NRI conversion, re-KYC)
* Ensure every interaction follows SEBI, RBI, KRA, KYC and AML guidelines, and that customer data stays protected
* Audit calls, chats and tickets, and turn feedback into better performance
* Build and improve SOPs and knowledge-base for operations team to ensure process standardization
* Spot trends in tickets and rejection reasons — and partner with product and tech to reduce repeat contacts
* Share clear performance MIS and customer insights with leadership

**What you’ll bring**

* Graduate in any discipline
* 4–7 years in operations and customer service in fintech, broking, banking including 1–2 years leading a team
* Strong knowledge of KYC and customer onboarding: PAN, Aadhaar eKYC, DigiLocker, video KYC, IPV, KRA, CKYC and re-KYC
* Working understanding of SEBI and RBI KYC norms for NRI accounts, and AML basics
* Familiarity with NRE/NRO/Foreign national account structures
* A track record of hitting Onboarding conversion, SLA, CSAT and quality targets
* Hands-on experience with CRM tools like Freshdesk, Zendesk or Salesforce
* Comfort with Excel or Google Sheets for reporting
* Excellent English and Hindi communication
* Experience of handling irate customers and sensitive escalations
* Flexibility for rotational shifts, including weekends - the role requires six day working

**Bonus points**

* Experience with demat or mutual fund opening for NRIs
* Familiarity with Mixpanel, Metabase or basic SQL
* Exposure to Six Sigma or COPC frameworks
* Experience hiring, building and scaling a support or operations team

**Why join us**

* Competitive salary with performance-linked incentives
* Health insurance for you and your family
* A clear growth path to senior roles leading a larger team
* Exposure of technology led problem solving working in a fast growing Fintech Startup

title: Technical Account Manager, ES - INDIA
description:
**Description**
AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.
  
  
Amazon has built a global reputation for being the most customer-centric company, a company that customers from all over the world recognize, value, and trust for both our products and services. Amazon has a fast-paced environment where we “Work Hard, Have Fun and Make History.”
  
  
As an increasing number of enterprises move their critical systems to the cloud, AWS India is in need of highly efficient technical consulting talent to help our largest and strategically important customers navigate the operational challenges and complexities of AWS Cloud. We are looking for Technical Consultants to support our customers creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies, including Compute, Storage, Database, Data Analytics, Application services, Networking, Server-less and more. This is not a sales role, but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor for organizations ranging from start-ups to large enterprises.
  
  
As a Technical Account Manager, you will be the primary technical point of contact for one or more customers helping to plan, debug, and oversee ongoing operations of business-critical applications. You will get your hands dirty, troubleshooting application, network, database, and architectural challenges using a suite of internal AWS Cloud tools as well as your existing knowledge and toolkits. We are seeking individuals with strong backgrounds in I.T. Consulting and in any of these related areas such as Solution Designing, Application and System Development, Database Management, Big Data and Analytics, DevOps Consulting, and Media technologies. Knowledge of programming and scripting is beneficial to the role.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Every day will bring new and exciting challenges on the job while you:
  
  

* Learn and use Cloud technologies.
* Interact with leading technologists around the world.
* Work on critical, highly complex customer problems that may span multiple AWS Cloud services.
* Apply advanced troubleshooting techniques to provide unique solutions to our customers' individual needs.
* Work directly with AWS Cloud subject matter experts to help reproduce and resolve customer issues.
* Write tutorials, how-to videos, and other technical articles for the customer community.
* Leverage your extensive customer support experience and provide feedback to internal AISPL teams on how to improve our services.
* Drive projects that improve support-related processes and our customers’ technical support experience.
* Assist in Design/Architecture of AWS and Hybrid cloud solutions.
* Help Enterprises define IT and business processes that work well with cloud deployments.
* Be available outside of business hours to help coordinate the handling of urgent issues as needed.

**About The Team**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS?
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of technical engineering experience
* Experience with operational parameters and troubleshooting for three (3) of the following: compute/storage/networking/CDN/databases/DevOps/big data and analytics/security/applications development in a distributed systems environment
* Bachelor's degree
* Bachelor's degree or above in computer science, engineering, analytics, mathematics, statistics, IT or equivalent, or Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent
* 7+ years of hands-on infrastructure, troubleshooting, systems administration, networking, DevOps or applications development experience
* Experience in external enterprise customer-facing role as a technical lead, with strong oral and written communication skills, presenting to both large and small audiences
* Experience managing multiple projects, prioritizing, planning, and managing time
* Be mobile and travel to client locations as needed.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with AWS services or other cloud offerings
* Experience in internal enterprise or external customer-facing environment as a technical lead

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: Customer Success Intern
description:
**About the Company** 




  





 HiAstro is a Vedic astrology platform built for an Indian audience that the rest of the industry tends to under\-serve. Our user base skews Tier 2 and Tier 3, and many of our users are encountering a product like this for the first time.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a sharp, curious, and people\-oriented Customer Experience Representative who can help us understand our users better.
 



  





 This is not just a support role. You will regularly speak with users, conduct interviews, test the product with real people, identify patterns in their behaviour and feedback, and bring useful insights back to the team.
 



  





**What You Will Do** 



* Speak with users over calls to understand their experience, concerns, and expectations
* Conduct structured user interviews and questionnaires
* Participate in on\-ground research approach people, get them to try HiAstro, observe their experience, and ask relevant follow\-up questions
* Identify recurring user pain points, behavioural patterns, and product gaps
* Test existing and new product experiences and proactively flag issues
* Document and synthesise feedback into clear, actionable insights for Product, Growth, and Operations
* Own user conversations and follow\-ups through closure
* Support the Customer support channel proactively



  





**What We are Looking For** 



* Excellent communication and people skills; comfortable speaking to strangers both over calls and in person
* Curious and perceptive able to ask good follow\-up questions rather than mechanically following a script
* Quick on their feet, with strong common sense and judgement
* Proactive and high\-ownership; doesn’t need constant instructions to move things forward
* Organised, dependable, and able to communicate findings clearly
* Comfortable working in a fast\-moving startup environment
* Fluent/comfortable in both Hindi and English



  





**Experience** 



* Prior experience in customer experience, user research, operations, sales, community, or another consumer\-facing role is a plus, but not mandatory



  





 We care more about curiosity, communication, judgement, and initiative than a specific degree or number of years of experience. Skills and tools can be taught; the ability to understand and connect with people is essential.
 



  





**Why Join HiAstro** 



* Opportunity to work on real\-world video projects from concept to execution
* Exposure to creative strategy, storytelling, and digital content production
* Mentorship and learning opportunities from experienced team members
* A fast\-moving, ambitious team that values ownership and speed
* Competitive stipend and growth opportunities as the team scales



 ﻿
 



**How to Apply** 




 Send your resume along with your portfolio to hr@astrosky.co.in.

description:
Sprinklr is the definitive, AI\-native platform for Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified\-CXM), empowering brands to deliver extraordinary experiences at scale — across every customer touchpoint.
   

  

 By combining human instinct with the speed and efficiency of AI, Sprinklr helps brands earn trust and loyalty through personalized, seamless, and efficient customer interactions. Sprinklr’s unified platform provides powerful solutions for every customer\-facing team — spanning social media management, marketing, advertising, customer feedback, and omnichannel contact center management — enabling enterprises to unify data, break down silos, and act on real\-time insights.
   

  

 Today, 1,900\+ enterprises and 60% of the Fortune 100 rely on Sprinklr to help them deliver consistent, trusted customer experiences worldwide.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Shift Timing:** 
 6 PM IST to 3 AM IST
   

  

 The
 **Senior CCaaS Implementation Consultant** 
 leads strategic implementation initiatives, ensuring Sprinklr customers receive exceptional onboarding, configuration, and long\-term platform value. This role blends deep technical proficiency with business acumen and leadership, guiding cross\-functional teams, mentoring peers, and acting as a senior escalation and consulting partner to enterprise clients.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead end\-to\-end implementation of Sprinklr's CCaaS solutions for complex enterprise clients across diverse industries, ensuring scalability, performance, and long\-term value.
* Define implementation strategy and solution architecture aligned with customer goals, industry standards, and best practices.

* Conduct advanced health checks and audits for key customers; design remediation and enhancement plans to improve platform performance and adoption.
* Lead client discovery workshops, requirement gathering sessions, and strategic planning for roadmap alignment and value realization.

* Deliver expert\-level consultation on Sprinklr capabilities, integrations, and CCaaS best practices.

**Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of experience in deploying Voice and Non\-Voice Contact Center applications such as Genesys Engage, Amazon Connect, Cisco Webex Contact Center, RingCentral, or similar platforms.
* Proven track record in leading complex implementation projects, preferably in CCaaS, UCaaS, or CPaaS environments.
* Deep understanding of voice technologies, protocols (TCP/IP, VOIP, SIP, RTP, WebRTC), and contact center infrastructure (ACD, IVR, CTI, Dialer, SBC).

* You maintain a customer\-first mindset, consistently exceeding expectations in high\-pressure environments.


**We focus on our mission** 
 : Sprinklr was founded in 2009 to solve a big problem: growing enterprise complexity that separated brands from their customers. Our vision was clear: to unify fragmented teams, tools and data — helping large organizations build deeper, more meaningful connections with the people they serve. Today, Sprinklr has a unified, AI\-native platform for four product suites: Sprinklr Service, Sprinklr Social, Sprinklr Marketing, and Sprinklr Insights. Sprinklr is here to do three things:
   

  

* Lead a new category of enterprise software that we call Unified\-CXM.
* Empower companies to deliver next generation, unified engagement journeys that reimagine the customer experience.
* Create a culture of customer obsession, with trust, teamwork, and accountability.


**We believe in our product**

 Technical Architect successfully designs and manages the delivery of complex Salesforce solutions for our customers. These technologies include\-\-but are not necessarily limited to Salesforce.com products and APIs, Apex/Visualforce, Lightning, mobile development technologies, and integration/ETL technologies.

 You are both a big picture thinker and in\-depth problem solver, your knowledge and skills are both broad and deep. You take pride in designing systems that stand up to high volumes and won't fail at critical points. You have a good mix of technical and enterprise skills when it comes to architecting a solution. The solutions you design are built for the long\-term and will scale with the customer's growth plans seamlessly. You have proven experience integrating systems via API’s as well as a strong development background.

**Requirements**
* Degree or equivalent proven experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core proficiencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)
* 9\-14 years CRM experience with a minimum of 6 years on the Salesforce platform
* Expert level understanding of End\-to\-End Field Service Implementation
* Good understanding of the Salesforce product suite, including Sales, Service, Marketing, and Community Clouds
* Understanding of systems architecture and ability to design scalable performance\-driven solutions
* Understanding of key design patterns and large data volume limitations and best practices
* Understanding of data sharing and visibility considerations and how these play into platform architecture
* Familiarity with platform authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth)
* Knowledge of data integration tools and experience integrating Salesforce with different business systems (ETL, CPQ, marketing automation, reporting, etc.)
* Strong understanding of environment management, release management, code versioning best practices, and deployment methodologies
* Experience with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL)
* Expert level experience defining the system architecture landscape, identifying gaps between current and desired end\-states, and delivering a comprehensive solution that will enable achievement of the desired business outcomes

 When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and

title: Account Director, Large Enterprise
description:
**About The Team**
 OpenAI’s mission is to build safe artificial general intelligence (AGI) which benefits all of humanity. This long\-term undertaking brings the world’s best scientists, engineers, and business professionals into one lab together to accomplish this.
   

  

 In pursuit of this mission, our Go To Market (GTM) team is responsible for helping customers learn how to leverage and deploy our highly capable AI products across their business. The team is made of Sales, Solutions, Support, Marketing, and Partnership professionals that work together to create valuable solutions that will help bring AI to as many users as possible.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Our Sales team has a unique mission to help customers understand the deep impact that highly capable AI models can bring to their business and users. This role is a mixture of technical understanding, vision, partnership, and value\-driven strategy.
   

  

 You’ll be a key driver of opportunities through the entire sales cycle, from pipeline generation to closure. You’ll work with researchers, engineers, and solution strategists to help customers evolve their industry with AI.
   

  

 This role will be based in Delhi.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Manage a small number of key accounts, developing and executing strategies for a comprehensive account plan.
* Lead our enterprise prospects’ journeys from consideration to successful deployment.
* Partner with solutions and research engineering to build and execute complex customer programs and projects.
* Own a consumption revenue target.
* Manage consumption revenue forecasts.
* Analyze key account metrics to create reports and provide insights to internal and external stakeholders.
* Closely monitor the industry landscape (people, competitors, partners, etc.) to contribute to product roadmap and other corporate strategies.
* Collaborate with solutions, marketing, communications, business operations, people operations, finance, product management, and engineering.
* Support the recruitment and onboarding of other teammates.
* Support the development of company culture.


**We're Seeking Someone With Experience In**
* 10\+ years selling platform\-as\-a\-service and/or software\-as\-a\-service.
* Achieving revenue targets \>$2M per year for more than 3 years.
* Designing and executing complex deal strategies.
* Supporting the growth of fast\-growing, high\-performance companies.
* Working directly with c\-level executives.
* Communicating technical concepts to customers and internal stakeholders.
* Leading high\-visibility customer events (CAB, conferences, product launches, etc.).
* Gathering, distilling, and processing complex market (industry, competitor, customer, prospect) intelligence.


**You Might Thrive In This Role If You**
* Are customer\-centric. You are motivated to deeply understand your customer’s priorities and help them achieve their vision for using our models to improve their products and services. You build strong relationships with executives and professionals across functions and serve as a trusted advisor.
* Have a passion or deep curiosity in artificial intelligence. You embrace the opportunity to help deploy our technology in a way that benefits humanity. You’re excited to educate our customers on AI and how to plan for the future.
* Are a builder. You are excited to impact how our company operates and scales. Your passion is building strong systems and processes from the ground up and executing them with precision.
* Are excited by new challenges. You don’t have the answers to every question up front, but the process of solving them invigorates you. Bespoke issues requiring multidimensional knowledge excite you. You’re willing to experiment with new solutions.
* Are a strategist. You deeply understand go to market best practices and raise the bar for our organization. You think and plan forward on the order of years and bring internal and external stakeholders along with your strategy.


**About OpenAI**
 OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general\-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.
   

  

 We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

title: Regional Growth Leaders
description:
**Company Description** 




  





 Metafusion is a Unified Video Intelligence Platform provider. A platform that that integrates big video data, Natural Language Processing, computer vision, and Generative AI to unlock the full potential of metadata. Its advanced AI powered video analytics engine enables customers to derive actionable insights through natural language search, visual data interpretation, and on\-the\-fly content generation. This unified platform transforms how users explore and interact with large video data repositories, driving informed decision\-making and innovation. Metafusion’s solutions support a wide range of industries, including Smart and Safe Cities, Surveillance, Traffic and Transportation, Warehousing and Logistics, Hospitality and Healthcare, Banking, and Retail.
 



  





**Job Description** 




  





 Growth Leader is Metafusion's revenue engine on the ground — a dual\-mandate leader who drives new business acquisition and nurtures long\-term strategic growth within a defined geographic territory. Beyond classic quota ownership, the growth leader functions as a leader, responsible for mapping the market, building a partner ecosystem, and positioning Metafusion's Vision AI portfolio (Metavisio, Metatraffic, PixelFACE etc) as the intelligence layer of choice across Critical Infra, PSUs, Smart City, Safe City, and Government \& Enterprise verticals.
 



  





 This role requires a commercially assertive, consultatively strong professional who can operate at both the CXO boardroom and the technical evaluation table — owning the full sales cycle from prospecting to contract closure.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**A. Revenue Ownership \& Quota Attainment** 



* Own and exceed the assigned annual revenue quota for the territory per AOP targets.
* Drive end\-to\-end deal closure for Metafusion's Video AI and Vision AI product suite across assigned accounts and geographies.
* Maintain a healthy pipeline coverage at all times, qualifying and progressing opportunities through CRM.
* Deliver accurate sales forecasts of committed numbers on a quarterly basis.



  





**B. Territory Planning \& Market Development** 



* Build and execute a structured Territory Business Plan (TBP) each quarter aligned to AOP priorities.
* Identify high\-potential verticals, critical infra, government bodies \& Enterprises (Police, Smart City, Safe City, ICCC, Traffic, Large Enterprises), PSUs, and other accounts within the territory.
* Map competitive landscape and develop counter\-positioning strategies.
* Track government tenders and proactively position Metafusion in the pre\-tendering stage.
* Maintain a living territory account map: whitespace, installed base, renewal pipeline, and upsell opportunities.



  





**C. Channel Partner \& SI Ecosystem Development** 



* Identify, onboard, and enable active channel partners / System Integrators (SIs) within the territory.
* Conduct quarterly partner business reviews, co\-selling, and joint GTM activities.
* Ensure partner pipeline is logged in CRM; manage deal registration and conflict resolution.
* Train partners on Metafusion's product portfolio, solution USPs, and competitive differentiation.



  





**D. Solution Selling \& Pre\-Sales Collaboration** 



* Work closely with Pre\-Sales / Solution Engineers to craft solution architectures, BoQs, and demos tailored to customer needs.
* Lead discovery conversations and translate customer pain points into compelling Metafusion use cases.
* Support RFP / RFI responses for government and enterprise bids, ensuring compliance, differentiation, and on\-time submission.
* Conduct technical evaluation workshops, PoC planning, and site assessment visits alongside Pre\-Sales.



  





**E. CXO Engagement \& Strategic Relationship Management** 



* Build trusted advisor relationships with C\-level and senior decision\-makers at target accounts \& verticals.
* Coordinate with delivery and customer success teams’ post\-sale to ensure smooth implementation and account expansion.



  





**F. CRM Discipline \& Sales Reporting** 



* Maintain 100% CRM hygiene — all opportunities, activities, contacts, and deal stages updated weekly.
* Submit weekly pipeline reports and monthly territory reviews.
* Participate in appraisal cycles with documented evidence against KRA/KPI framework.



  





**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS \& EXPERIENCE** 




  





**Education** 



* B.E. / B. Tech in Electronics, Computer Science, IT, or related engineering discipline.
* MBA in Sales, Marketing, or Business Management preferred (not mandatory for proven performers).



  





**Experience** 



* 7–8 years of B2B sales experience with at least 3 years in technology / SaaS / Video Surveillance / AI solutions.
* Demonstrated track record of quota achievement.
* Experience selling to Critical Infra, Government (Smart City, Traffic, Safe City), PSUs, or Enterprise accounts is strongly preferred.
* Exposure to tender\-driven procurement processes is a significant advantage.
* Prior experience managing channel partners / SIs in a technology sales context.



  





**Domain Knowledge** 



* Working familiarity with Video Management Systems (VMS), AI Video Analytics, ANPR/LPR, Facial Recognition, or Surveillance infrastructure.
* Awareness of Enterprise Safe City / ICCC / Smart Traffic deployments in the Indian market.
* Understanding of procurement cycles, DPR preparation, and solution architecture basics.



  





**WHY METAFUSION?** 




  




* Work at the intersection of AI, Video Intelligence, and Smart Infrastructure — one of India's fastest\-growing technology domains.
* Opportunity to be a founding GTM team member — shape market strategy, not just execute it.
* Uncapped earning potential.
* Direct access to leadership — flat hierarchy, fast decisions, and merit\-driven career progression.
* Comprehensive product portfolio across Smart City, Traffic Management, Surveillance, and Enterprise AI verticals.



  





**Positions open for territories of Delhi/NCR, North, East \& West Regions.**

title: Sr Manager, Strategy & Operations
description:
The Trade Desk is a global technology company and the world’s leading independent platform for digital advertising, with over 3,000 employees across more than 30 offices. Our technology helps advertisers reach the right audiences across the open internet — from streaming TV and podcasts to mobile apps, news, and more.
   

  

 Advertising powers the content people love. By making it more transparent, effective, and responsible, we help support trusted journalism, quality entertainment, and creators worldwide. The world’s brands and agencies rely on us to reach their customers and grow their businesses responsibly.
   

  

 The scale of our platform brings unique technical challenges — from processing massive datasets in real time to building systems that operate reliably on a global scale. When you work here, your impact is worldwide. We welcome diverse perspectives, encourage curiosity, and build teams that learn from one another. If you’re driven to solve meaningful challenges, we’d love to meet you.
   

  

 The Trade Desk is helping shape the future of digital advertising, and APAC \& EMEA are the most dynamic places to build that future. As APAC \& EMEA Strategy \& Operations (S\&O) resets from ad\-hoc executor to strategic advisor, we are standing up two accountable pillars: RevOps \& Sales Enablement, and Systems \& XFN Enablement to give the region the scalable frameworks and operating discipline it needs for sustained double\-digit growth.
   

  

 We're looking for a hands\-on operator who thrives on turning systems and process chaos into trusted, self\-serve foundations, someone who is as comfortable rolling up their sleeves in Salesforce (or equivalent platforms) as they are coaching a country manager through change. If you're energised by fixing the plumbing so teams can focus on customers, this is where you'll do some of your best work.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
 Reporting into the APAC Director, Systems \& XFN Enablement, you'll own the execution layer that turns the region's systems foundation from a source of friction into a source of trust. Today, channel management activities (such as, mapping rework and change requests) pull Business Development \& Client Services managers and sellers off customers; you'll close that gap for good.
   

  

  

* Own Salesforce hygiene end\-to\-end, empowering Sales teams with tools for a frictionless \& efficient experience.
* Support systems transformation at regional and global level.
* Run change management and self\-serve training series with managers, including relationship methodology as well as 1:many governance cadences with the Salesforce champion community.
* Operate governance gates for rev\-group creation and maintain a clean audit trail, partnering with Finance, HR and Deal Desk.
* Support the Top Accounts process and outbound account management logic as part of the broader sales enablement agenda and contribute to the redesign of the Ops rhythm (Weekly Revenue Call, Quarterly \& Annual Planning).
* Track and report against success measures (mapping accuracy, backlog, adoption, meetings/FTE, training completion) to demonstrate ROI and free up selling time for GTM teams.
* Identify and build automation for standard workflows, processes and reporting, in partnership with engineering where needed.


**Who You Are**
* 8\-10 years in Sales Ops, Revenue Ops, Systems/Salesforce administration or Strategy, ideally in ad tech, SaaS or digital media.
* Deep, hands\-on Salesforce or CRM expertise (account/territory mapping, workflow rules, Portfolio Manager App or equivalent tooling); Tableau or Power BI experience is a strong plus.
* A track record of designing durable, self\-serve processes rather than one\-off fixes — you build the reusable rule, not just the one\-time exception.
* Comfortable running change management directly with frontline managers: training, governance cadences, and building trust that the new system works.
* Detail\-obsessed and data\-driven, with the judgement to know when a process needs to flex versus when to hold the governance line.
* A collaborative operator who partners naturally across Finance, HR, Deal Desk, Sales and Engineering to get things done.


**Why this role, why now**
 At TTD, values like Vision, Grit, Agility, Generosity, Openness, and Full\-Heartedness show up in how we work with one another every day. We're building a team that reflects the diversity of the markets we serve, and we warmly welcome people from all backgrounds who are excited to help shape what comes next.
   

  

 As an Equal Opportunity Employer, The Trade Desk is committed to creating an inclusive hiring experience where everyone has the opportunity to thrive.
   

  

 Please reach out to us at accommodations@ thetradedesk. com to request an accommodation or discuss any accessibility needs you may require to access our Company Website or navigate any part of the hiring process.
   

  

 When you contact us, please include your preferred contact details and specify the nature of your accommodation request or questions. Any information you share will be handled confidentially and will not impact our hiring decisions.

 You'll become the primary point of contact for key customers, understand their business goals, identify opportunities to expand their use of AiSensy, and work with internal teams to make sure they succeed.
 



  





 Your goal is to move customers from:
 



**Customer → Active Customer → Growing Customer → Strategic AiSensy Account** 




  





 You'll work closely with
 **Sales, Customer Success, Product, Support, Marketing, Partnerships, and Leadership** 
 to drive customer outcomes.
 



  





 We want someone who can build strong executive relationships, understand business problems, spot expansion opportunities, and
 **take ownership until things get done.** 




  





**What You'll Own** 




**1\. Enterprise Account Ownership** 



* Own a portfolio of strategic and enterprise customers.
* Act as the primary point of contact for assigned accounts.
* Build strong relationships with key stakeholders and decision\-makers.
* Understand each customer's business model, objectives, challenges, and WhatsApp strategy.
* Establish regular account review and engagement cadences.
* Build strong relationships across multiple stakeholders within each account.
* Ensure customers receive a high\-quality AiSensy experience.
* Maintain a clear understanding of account health, risks, opportunities, and next steps.



  





**2\. Account Growth \& Revenue Expansion** 




 Your responsibility doesn't end once the customer is onboarded.
 



**You will actively identify opportunities to grow the account.** 



* Identify expansion opportunities within existing enterprise accounts.
* Drive upsell and cross\-sell opportunities across AiSensy's products.
* Identify opportunities around:
* WhatsApp Marketing
* Click\-to\-WhatsApp Ads
* AI Agents
* Automation
* Conversational Commerce
* Payments
* Expand AiSensy's presence across business units, teams, products, and use cases.
* Build account\-specific growth plans.
* Work with Sales and Product teams to convert opportunities into revenue.
* Maintain a healthy expansion pipeline across assigned accounts.
* Track account revenue, usage, adoption, and expansion potential.



  





**3\. Strategic Account Planning** 




 Build a clear growth plan for every strategic account.
 



 For each customer, understand:
 



**Where are they today?** 




**What are they using AiSensy for?** 




**What are they not using yet?** 




**What business problem can we solve next?** 




**Who are the decision\-makers?** 




**What can the account become?** 



* Create account plans for key customers.
* Map stakeholders and decision\-makers.
* Understand customer business priorities and upcoming initiatives.
* Identify whitespace opportunities across products and teams.
* Build quarterly and annual account growth plans.
* Track progress against account\-level objectives.
* Present account plans and growth opportunities internally.



  





**4\. Customer Engagement \& Executive Relationships** 




 Build relationships beyond the day\-to\-day user.
 


* Conduct regular business reviews with enterprise customers.
* Engage senior stakeholders and decision\-makers.
* Present AiSensy solutions based on business objectives.
* Share product updates, industry insights, and relevant use cases.
* Identify opportunities to bring AiSensy leadership into strategic conversations.
* Build relationships that support long\-term retention and expansion.
* Act as the voice of the customer internally.



 The goal is to become a
 **trusted business partner** 
 , not just another vendor contact.
 



  





**5\. Product Adoption \& Customer Success** 




 Help customers get more value from AiSensy.
 


* Monitor product adoption and account usage.
* Identify underutilized products and features.
* Educate customers on new AiSensy capabilities.
* Work with Customer Success and Product teams to improve adoption.
* Identify accounts showing declining engagement or usage.
* Build action plans for at\-risk accounts.
* Ensure customer issues are followed through to resolution.
* Collect customer feedback and communicate meaningful insights to Product and Leadership.



  





**6\. Customer Growth Programs** 




 Develop structured programs to increase engagement and business outcomes across enterprise accounts.
 


* Create account\-specific growth and adoption plans.
* Identify high\-impact WhatsApp use cases.
* Share best practices and successful customer use cases.
* Help customers improve their WhatsApp marketing and engagement strategy.
* Drive adoption of new AiSensy products and capabilities.
* Identify opportunities to replicate successful use cases across different teams or business units.



  





**7\. Cross\-Functional Execution** 




 Enterprise accounts require strong internal coordination.
 



 Work closely with:
 


* Sales
* Customer Success
* Product
* Customer Support
* Marketing
* Partnerships
* Engineering
* Leadership



 to ensure smooth execution across strategic accounts.
 



 You will coordinate internal teams, manage expectations, remove blockers, and ensure commitments made to customers are followed through.
 



**You own the outcome—even when multiple teams are involved.** 




  





**8\. Retention \& Account Health** 




 Own the overall health of your accounts.
 



 Monitor:
 


* Product usage
* Customer engagement
* Revenue
* Expansion
* Renewal
* Support issues
* Customer satisfaction
* Stakeholder relationships



 Identify churn risks early.
 



 Build account recovery plans where required.
 



 Work proactively rather than waiting for the customer to raise a problem.
 



  





**9\. Customer Advocacy \& Strategic Relationships** 




 Turn successful customers into long\-term AiSensy advocates.
 


* Identify customers with strong business outcomes.
* Build opportunities for:
* Case studies
* Customer testimonials
* Customer stories
* Webinars
* Events
* References
* Brand Showcase
* Work with Marketing to showcase customer success.
* Build relationships that create opportunities for referrals and introductions.



  





**10\. Reporting \& Account Intelligence** 




 Maintain strong visibility into your account portfolio.
 



 Track:
 


* Account revenue
* Expansion revenue
* Product adoption
* Usage
* Renewal status
* Account health
* Pipeline
* Upsell opportunities
* Customer risks
* Key stakeholder relationships



 Maintain accurate CRM records and account plans.
 



 Provide regular updates on:
 



**What's growing?** 




**What's at risk?** 




**What's the opportunity?** 




**What needs leadership attention?** 




  





**What We're Looking For** 




  





**Must Have** 



* **4–7 years of experience** 
 in Key Account Management, Enterprise Account Management, Customer Success, Account Growth, or Business Development.
* Proven experience managing and growing
 **existing enterprise/B2B accounts** 
 .
* Experience owning a portfolio of strategic customers.
* Track record of driving
 **upsell, cross\-sell, expansion, retention, or account revenue growth** 
 .
* Strong understanding of B2B SaaS and enterprise customer relationships.
* Strong stakeholder and relationship management skills.
* Experience interacting with senior decision\-makers.
* Strong commercial understanding and negotiation skills.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* Strong problem\-solving and project management abilities.
* Ability to coordinate multiple internal teams to deliver customer outcomes.
* Strong ownership and follow\-through.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-moving startup environment.



  





**Good to Have**

 **B2B SaaS, MarTech, CPaaS, CRM, FinTech, AI, automation, or technology**

 .

* Experience with customer expansion and land\-and\-expand models.
* Experience working with agencies, resellers, or technology partners.
* Experience with CRM tools such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho, or similar.
* Strong understanding of digital marketing and customer engagement.



  





**What Will Make You Stand Out** 



* You've
 **grown large enterprise accounts significantly** 
 .
* You can demonstrate measurable expansion or revenue growth from existing customers.
* You know how to find whitespace inside an account.
* You've successfully expanded relationships from one team/business unit to multiple.
* You can engage both users and senior decision\-makers.
* You understand customer business problems—not just product features.
* You know how to run a strong QBR and turn it into an account\-growth conversation.
* You proactively identify churn risks before they become problems.
* You can coordinate multiple teams and still own the final outcome.
* You have experience selling additional products into existing accounts.
* You can turn successful customers into references, case studies, and advocates.



  





**Why Join AiSensy?** 




  





**Work With Recognized Brands** 




 You'll work directly with businesses including
 **Adani, Vivo, PhysicsWallah, Godrej, Wipro, Asian Paints, India Today Group and more.** 




  





**Work on a High\-Impact Product** 




 Businesses use AiSensy to acquire, engage, sell, and support customers through WhatsApp.
 



 The product directly connects to customer engagement and revenue.
 



  





**Build Strategic Relationships** 




 You'll work with enterprise businesses and senior stakeholders rather than managing transactional accounts.
 



  





**Real Ownership** 




 You'll own:
 



**Relationship \+ Adoption \+ Retention \+ Expansion \+ Revenue** 




 Grow With the Category
 



  





 AiSensy is building across

**The Bottom Line** 




 We're looking for a

**"What else can AiSensy do for us?"**
