**come build with us.**

title: AGM - P&L lead (ID # 915)
description:
As P\&L Lead, you will be accountable for how the client's enterprise customers experience, adopt, and derive lasting value from their Voice AI platform. You will partner deeply with customers, from feasibility and onboarding through to stabilization and long\-term success.This role sits at the intersection of product delivery, execution, customer success, deployment excellence, and business outcomes.
 



  





 You will own the complete customer journey for a set of key accounts, ensuring that every deployment translates into measurable business outcomes. You will work closely with the pod leads and central teams to maintain execution excellence, strong account health, and scalable delivery practices.
 



  





 We are already India's largest Voice AI player, with the strongest product and a clear opportunity ahead. It is time to accelerate a decisive land grab. If you are excited about building at the frontier of AI and turning cutting\-edge technology into transformative outcomes for enterprise customers, this is your playground.
 



  





**What You'll Be Doing** 




  




* Own the P\&L for the assigned portfolio, balancing revenue growth and business outcomes, deliver quality and operational efficiency.
* Run feasibility analysis before signing up new customers, ensuring the right fit and setting up deployments for success from day one
* Manage the complete product delivery lifecycle: onboarding, implementation, go\-live, stabilization, and ongoing success

* Proven experience in team management, including hiring, mentoring and leading high\-performing cross\-functional teams



  





**Why should you consider us seriously?** 



* We believe that long\-term, people over product and profits, prioritize culture over everything else.
* We are a well\-balanced team of experienced entrepreneurs and are backed by top investors across India and Silicon Valley (Chiratae Ventures, Blume Ventures, Abstract Ventures, Emergent Ventures; Senior execs at Google, Square, Genpact \& Flipkart; Co\-founders of Infosys, Snapdeal, Slideshare, Zomato, etc.)

You act like an owner, move with velocity through change, finding innovative and strategic ways to consistently deliver extraordinary and incremental outcomes for both Google and your customers. title: Brand Partnerships Manager
description:
**About Us** 




  





**Tooused** 
 powers circularity for India's leading brands, retailers, textile producers, and households.
 



  





**Tooused's** 
 vision is to divert 1 billion textiles from landfill by 2030, recycling them for a second life instead, and we’re on track to do it with India's first full\-stack textile recycling platform. This platform is setting the course for the future of the industry, connecting textile waste to responsible end\-of\-life options, meaningfully addressing the textile waste crisis, and redefining the sustainability narrative for the next generation – to one that is win\-win\-win for brands, consumers, and our planet.
 



  





**About the role** 




  





 We are building
 **TakeBack** 
 for Brands. It gives a brand everything it needs to run its own take\-back programme without building any of it, including reverse logistics across the country, chain of custody on every garment, and the reporting brands will need as India's textile EPR rules take shape.
 



  





 We already have early interest from brands like NewMe, No Nasties, Mahina and Debaans. What we do not have yet is one person who owns this line end to end. That is this role.
 



  





 You will be the first commercial hire on
 **TakeBack** 
 . You will find the brands, run the pitch, close the deal, and then stay on to get the programme live with our ops and tech teams. This is not a role where you hand off after signature. At our stage, the person who sells it is the person who makes it work.
 



  





**What you will do** 




  




* Build and run the brand pipeline, from cold outreach and events to inbound and referrals
* Own the full sales cycle, including discovery, pitch, commercials, negotiation and close
* Design each brand's take\-back programme with them, covering collection format, customer incentive, logistics flow and reporting
* Work with our ops and tech teams to launch signed brands and keep them running
* Be the brand's main point of contact after go\-live, and own renewal and expansion
* Build the pitch materials as you go, including decks, pricing models, and case studies
* Track what is and is not working in the funnel and tell us plainly
* Keep on top of EPR and textile regulation in India, and translate it into a reason for brands to act now



  





**What we are looking for** 





 This is a hands\-on commercial role with responsibility for building the pipeline, winning business, and getting programmes live.
 




  




* **2 to 5 years** 
 in B2B retail sales, partnerships, key accounts, or category management
* Background in fashion, retail, D2C, sustainability
* **Create opportunities proactively:** 
 You will research brands, identify decision\-makers, initiate outreach, and follow up consistently. The founders will support important conversations; you will own keeping opportunities moving.
* **Work towards agreed outcomes:** 
 We will set targets for qualified brand conversations, proposals, signed agreements, and programme launches. A qualified conversation should establish a relevant need, the decision\-making process, and a clear next step.
* **Keep the pipeline current:** 
 Record meaningful activity in our shared CRM or tracker by the next working day. Every active opportunity should show the contact, latest discussion, stage, next action, and follow\-up date.
* **Make progress and blockers visible:** 
 Share a weekly update covering what moved forward, what stalled, why, and what support you need. Raise risks early and recommend a next step.
* **Own delivery with the team:** 
 Confirm operational and technical feasibility before making commitments. After signature, coordinate the launch, track open issues, and keep the brand informed until they are resolved.
* **Ensure continuity:** 
 When an account changes hands or your engagement ends, provide an organised handover covering contacts, commitments, documents, pending actions, and timelines. Another team member should be able to continue the work from those records.



  





**What we are not looking for** 




  




* Someone who only wants to work warm inbound
* Someone who needs a fully built product, a fixed price list, and a finished deck on day one
* Someone who treats sustainability as a talking point rather than an operating problem



  





**Why this is worth your time** 




  





 Textile EPR is coming to India. When it lands, every mid and large apparel brand in the country will need a take\-back partner, and very few will want to build the infrastructure themselves. We already have the grid running. This role is the person who turns that into a business before the rules force everyone to catch up.
 



  





 You will report directly to the founder, and you will own the line rather than a slice of it. If it works, you build the team under it.
 



  





**Compensation** 




  





 Fixed salary plus performance\-linked incentive on signed and launched brands. ESOPs on the table for the right person. We will talk numbers openly in the first call.
 



  





**How to apply** 




  





 Send your CV to hello@tooused.com with a short note on one brand you think should be running a take\-back programme in India and how you would get to them. We read those notes.

**💻 Position: Senior Enterprise Solutions Manager \- Brand \& Engagement** 




**📍Location: Delhi** 




**🗓️ Working Days: Monday to Friday** 




**📌 Experience Required: 4–7 years** 




  





**About the Role** 




 Own the
 **end\-to\-end implementation and growth of FMCG brand campaigns post\-sale** 
 — getting them live, setting up tooling/dashboards, handling SQL, legal/ops, and building solutions when standard processes don’t fit.
 



  





**The Role** 



* You own what happens after a brand signs — and part of what happens just before.
* You take a signed (or near\-signed) enterprise brand and stand up a working, measurable campaign: configuring internal tooling, building the demo/sandbox the brand evaluates, wiring up their analytics dashboards, and clearing the legal and operational steps between contract and go\-live.
* When the standard path doesn't fit a brand's ask, you design one. And you feed every recurring gap back to Product, so the next deployment is faster.
* This is a builder's seat, not a relationship\-management seat. You'll be measured on getting brands live, instrumented and expanding — not on meeting cadence.



  





**What You'll Do** 



* **Demos \& sandboxes:** 
 Build the demo environments and proof\-of\-concept setups brands evaluate, in coordination with the founding team.
* **Solutioning:** 
 Translate a brand's objective into a concrete campaign configuration. Invent workarounds when our defaults don't fit.
* **Customer setup:** 
 Configure and launch new enterprise customers in our internal tools. Own time\-to\-first\-live\-campaign.
* **Analytics:** 
 Stand up and maintain customer\-facing dashboards so every brand can see purchase intent and campaign outcomes without having to ask.
* **Cross\-functional coordination:** 
 Drive legal (MSAs, DPAs, brand \& procurement reviews) and operations (fulfilment, sampling logistics) to unblock go\-live.
* **Account outcomes:** 
 Own the ongoing result — accounts that stay live and grow because they're properly instrumented. Catch risk in the data before it surfaces at renewal, not after.
* **Product partnership:** 
 Surface recurring friction, scope it with Product, and help shape the tooling built specifically for this function.



  





**Requirements** 



* 4–7 years in solutions engineering, implementation / onboarding, technical account management, or enterprise customer success at a B2B SaaS, martech or adtech company.
* Hands\-on data fluency. You build dashboards from raw data, not just read them — hands\-on SQL, plus a BI tool (Metabase, Looker, Power BI, Tableau).
* Ownership in ambiguity. You've run an implementation or a complex onboarding end\-to\-end, not just managed a relationship around one.
* Enterprise stakeholder management. You've sat across from brand / marketing, procurement and legal — ideally in or around FMCG / CPG brand teams or their agencies (WPP, Publicis, Mindshare, Dentsu).
* Communication. Sharp written and verbal; you can run a room of senior client stakeholders.

 • 5\+ years of experience with significant ownership of a P\&L, business unit, category or large revenue charter.

 • Strong sales, go\-to\-market, commercial and analytical capability.
 



 • Experience building teams and developing managers or second\-line leaders.

description:
Implementation Manager
 



 Function: Customer Delivery \& Implementation \| Travel: As\-Required (customer site) \| Reports to: Head\- AI Value Delivery
 



  





 Mission
 



 Own and deliver the customer roadmap, including AI use cases and platform features end to end. The Implementation Manager is the organization's principal representative at the customer, driving delivery, stakeholder coordination, adoption, and value tracking.
 



  





 Role Overview
 



 The Implementation Manager represents the organization on\-site at the customer and acts as the single point of accountability for that customer's roadmap. This role owns the relationship between the customer and internal teams (engineering, solutioning, and platform) ensuring they are aligned and mobilized around agreed customer outcomes. The Implementation Manager travels to customer sites as needed, builds and protects customer trust, and owns customer\-facing outcomes and deliverables.
 



 Each Implementation Manager manages multiple accounts at a time and is expected to develop a deep working understanding of each customer's business context, priorities, and constraints to make sound delivery and prioritization calls on their behalf.
 



 Base Location should be Delhi NCR / Bhopal.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



 • Own and drive the customer roadmap, including AI use case delivery and adoption, from commitment through to realized value.

 Success Metrics

 Focus Areas (Outcomes)

 • Demonstrated ability to manage ambiguity, competing priorities, and multiple concurrent accounts.
 



 • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with executive presence.
 



 • Willingness and ability to travel to customer sites as required

title: Growth Manager - Enterprise Growth (Digital Commerce)
description:
**Company Overview** 




  





 GobbleCube is an agentic growth operating system designed to help brands scale profitably across digital marketplaces. Founded in November 2022 by the ex\- core team of Blinkit, the platform went live commercially from private beta in September 2024\.
 



  





 Since then, GobbleCube has scaled rapidly, supporting 600\+ brands across enterprise and D2C, growing revenue 10X, and onboarding 45 of India’s largest CPG enterprises in just the last 9 months, including HUL, Nivea, Tata Consumer Products, ITC, Godrej, Beiersdorf, MTR, L’Oréal, Hershey’s, and many more.
 



  





 As commerce becomes more distributed and hyperlocal, GobbleCube is building agentic solutions to help brands navigate complexity in real time, across visibility, performance marketing, supply chain, and growth strategy. Headquartered in Gurugram, the company supports brands across India, MENA, and LATAM.
 



  





**About the role** 




 India's largest CPG brands do business worth hundreds of crores every year on Quick Commerce platforms. They lose share for reasons invisible from a 360 dashboard: a dark\-store availability gap, a competitor outbidding them on a category keyword, a discount ladder that buys volume at the cost of contribution margin.
 



 GobbleCube finds those reasons. Your job is to walk into the brand's boardroom, tell the CXO what is happening, recommend what to do about it, and get a room of senior people who might disagree to commit to a decision.
 



  





**What this role is not** 




 This is not a marketing growth role. No funnel, no CAC, no acquisition budget, and no performance campaigns to run. If you are a growth marketer, this isn't the job you want.
 



 This is also not a traditional Customer Success role. You are not measured on tickets closed, QBR decks delivered, or logins. Nobody here will ask you to "drive adoption."
 



 The closest analogue is what an MBB consultant does for a CPG client, except you do it under a productised strategic consulting environment, for India's largest CPG brands at once, with a product doing the work in the background.
 



  





**What you will actually do** 



* Run regular strategic connects (online and in\-person both) with each account's senior leadership. Not a status update. A point of view on their business, and recommendations backed by data, to drive their business objectives.
* Diagnose why an output metric moved: market share, offtake, margin, etc. Decompose it into availability, visibility, discounting and supply chain. Then decide what is worth acting on.
* Take a difficult position to a senior stakeholder and make it land. Frequently the recommendation is "stop doing the thing that makes your number this month."
* Build the quarterly impact story: problem identified, action recommended, outcome achieved, revenue or share impact, in the brand's own numbers.
* Find the next business problem worth solving, prove it in a pilot, and convert it into expansion revenue.
* Turn what worked on one account into a repeatable SOP or a product requirement, so the ninth account does not need a ninth person.



  





**Who you will be in the room with** 




 CMOs, Sales Heads, E\-commerce Heads, Supply Chain Heads, occasionally CFOs. They are senior, have limited face time, and each of them wants something different from the same budget. Their KAMs and brand managers are your day\-to\-day.
 



  





**What makes this different from consulting** 




 The dogwork is automated. RCA, data pulls, anomaly detection, competitive tracking, and most of the analysis run through the product and agentic workflows in the backend. You are deciding what the analysis means, what to recommend (the right action at the right time), and how to get it approved. That is also the bar. When the analysis is free, the analysis is not the value. Your judgement is.
 



  





**How you will be measured** 



* Net revenue retention across your portfolio. Zero downsell, plus expansion.
* A documented, quantified impact story per account per quarter.
* Pilot\-to\-conversion rate on expansion modules.
* Qualified expansion opportunities briefed to GTM with a written business case.
* No account goes Amber without you flagging it first.
* Strategic connect coverage and conversation quality across your book.



  





**You will do well here if** 



* You can hold your position when a senior stakeholder tells you your data is wrong, without either backing down or repeating "the data says so."
* You are comfortable being the least senior person in the room and still owning the recommendation.
* You end conversations with an owner, a decision, a metric and a review date, rather than with an action\-items list.
* You would rather be right in eight weeks than agreeable today.



  





**You will struggle here if** 



* You need a clean brief before you can start.
* You want analysis to be your main contribution.
* Confrontation with senior stakeholders drains you.



  





**Requirements** 



* Bachelor's or Master's from a Tier 1 institute (IIT, IIM, ISB and equivalent).
* 3\-7 years in management consulting, strategy and ops, growth, or enterprise customer success at a B2B SaaS company. Consumer or retail exposure is a strong plus.
* Structured problem\-solving you can demonstrate live, not just describe.
* Presentation and stakeholder management skills at CXO level.
* Strong Excel. Enough SQL to interrogate an analysis and find the hole in it.

title: Technology Account Lead
description:
**Project Role :** 
 Technology Account Lead
   

  

**Project Role Description :** 
 Function as primary contact for technology work at each account. Integrate technology contracts and engagements at the client. Leverage all technology offerings to expand the scope of technology work at the account (up\-sell/cross\-sell). Create the technology account plan and get the right people involved to maximize the opportunity and build the account.
   

  

**Must have skills :** 
 Delivery Excellence
   

  

**Good to have skills :** 
 Delivery Operations Control
   

  

**Minimum 15 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :** 
 15 years full time education
   

  

 Role Summary
   

  

 The Delivery Lead is responsible for coordinating end\-to\-end delivery of services to key enterprise customers, including execution oversight across programs/projects/contracted services, and monitoring, managing, and reporting on deliverables and service performance. The role requires experience in a multinational environment and familiarity with Business Excellence frameworks and/or service delivery practices
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Lead and/or support development of supplier/vendor/sub\-contractor strategy for service delivery operations.
   

  

 Identify, understand, and implement tools/initiatives that drive efficiency gains across delivery.
   

  

 Manage recruiting, staffing, pyramid mix, utilization, and capacity planning to balance cost and delivery targets.
   

  

 Resolve delivery performance issues in collaboration with delivery leadership and stakeholders.
   

  

 Support and contribute to strategic initiatives that improve delivery outcomes for clients by partnering with relevant internal teams
   

  

 Formalize delivery plans with service group delivery leadership and ensure execution across one or more delivery operations.
   

  

 Drive efficiencies through standard processes, synergies, and continuous improvement levers (e.g., operational excellence / Six Sigma).
   

  

 Manage supply and demand, service quality, and delivery processes to meet expectations, while continuously improving methods and outcomes.
   

  

 Proactively strengthen customer relationships through regular engagement, partnering with Client Account and Account Delivery leadership.
   

  

 Deliver the agreed scope of services while driving profitability improvements and productivity gains.
   

  

 Manage and reduce costs on standard offerings, assets, technologies, licenses, and facilities where applicable.
   

  

 Implement and track SLAs and associated financial/operational metrics support achievement of contract controllable income (CCI) and cost\-to\-serve targets.
   

  

 Support estimate\-at\-completion (EAC) adjustments when required and drive year\-on\-year efficiencies with delivery service providers.
   

  

 Act as an escalation point for delivery managers/project managers and clients to ensure customer satisfaction and timely resolution of concerns.
   

  

 Own service delivery across operations including incident and change management (as applicable to the delivery scope).
   

  

 Participate in account quality review processes and engage in the quality assurance program as required.
   

  

 Review and validate standard solutions/models for new deals and take accountability for execution/completion.
   

  

 Track duties and deliverables across multiple project managers and their respective projects to ensure delivery governance and control.
   

  

 Lead career management for service delivery staff (training, engagement, mentoring, succession planning, and annual performance processes).
   

  

 Act as a subject matter expert (SME), providing deep expertise and guidance to teams to optimize delivery of standard solutions.
   

  

**Required Skills / Competencies (Must Have)**
 Strong oral and written English communication skills with ability to engage directly with clients.
   

  

 Proven leadership capabilities with ability to motivate teams to meet goals and deadlines.
   

  

 Conflict resolution and negotiation skills to balance customer needs with organizational priorities
   

  

 Effective delegation and execution management ability to produce clear, functional reports for technical and non\-technical audiences.
   

  

 Ability to lead complex projects/programs where new services/tools may be introduced or created strong problem identification and action orientation
   

  

 Capability to monitor performance, identify improvement opportunities, and drive service improvement activities with clients and operations teams.
   

  

 Experience working with global teams and offshore/nearshore delivery models.
   

  

 Strong client management and relationship\-building experience.
   

  

**Preferred Skills (Good To Have)**
 Certifications such as PMP / Agile / Scrum / Six Sigma.
   

  

 Experience Guidelines (Adjustable per Level)
   

  

 10\+ years leading delivery (program/project/service delivery) with demonstrated ownership of SLA and operational outcomes.
   

  

 15\+ years of client management and relationship\-building experience (where applicable to role scope).
   

  

 Success Measures (What Good Looks Like)
   

  

 Consistent SLA adherence and strong customer satisfaction through effective escalation management.
   

  

 Improved delivery efficiency through standardization, synergies, and continuous improvement.
   

  

 Strong financial discipline via CCI, cost\-to\-serve targets, and accurate EAC governance.
   

  

 Healthy staffing/utilization and capability development through mentoring, training, and succession planning.

 Netweb Technologies India Limited is seeking an experienced Service Delivery Lead – Data Center \& Infrastructure to lead the post\-sales service and customer delivery function for its growing portfolio of enterprise infrastructure, data center, HPC, AI and high\-performance computing solutions.

 Own the end\-to\-end post\-sales service lifecycle for enterprise servers, storage, HPC, AI/GPU infrastructure and associated data center solutions.Ensure effective transition from project delivery to service operations and establish clear ownership, governance and escalation mechanisms for strategic customers.Lead service reviews with key customers and act as the senior escalation point for critical incidents, ensuring timely resolution, transparent communication and sustained customer confidence.Provide leadership across hardware support and infrastructure services, with a strong understanding of enterprise servers, storage, GPU systems, HPC infrastructure and associated data center components.Partner with Engineering, Product and OEM teams to resolve complex technical issues, customer locations.Drive improvements in engineer productivity, first\-time resolution, response time and overall field effectiveness.Establish and continuously improve service governance frameworks covering SLA adherence, MTTR, first\-time\-fix rate, repeat failures, ticket aging, escalation closure, customer satisfaction and service backlog.Develop executive\-level service dashboards and review mechanisms to provide management with clear visibility into service performance, risks, customer escalations and improvement priorities.Own the service\-spares ecosystem covering critical spare planning, inventory availability, RMA, repair and replacement cycles and service logistics.Work closely with Supply Chain, Warehousing, Engineering and service partners to ensure availability of critical components and minimize customer downtime.Drive optimization of service inventory, repair cycles and associated operational costs without compromising service commitments.Provide operational leadership for warranty and AMC services, ensuring contractual commitments and customer SLAs are consistently delivered.Partner with Sales and Commercial teams to strengthen AMC and extended warranty propositions, improve renewal readiness and identify opportunities for sustainable service revenue growth.Maintain a strong understanding of service cost structures, partner commercials, SLA commitments and service profitability.Work closely with Sales, Presales, Project Delivery, Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain and Finance to create a unified customer experience across the complete lifecycle.Build a culture of accountability, operational discipline and continuous improvement within the service organization.Develop talent, strengthen technical capability and establish processes that can scale with Netweb's business growth.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 The ideal candidate will have 12–18 years of progressive experience in post\-sales service delivery, field service, technical services or infrastructure service operations, preferably within enterprise technology, data center, server, storage, HPC or AI infrastructure environments. An engineering degree in Electronics, Electrical, Computer Science, Information Technology, Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline is preferred.
   

  

**Required Skills**
 Strong working knowledge of enterprise hardware platforms, including servers, storage, GPU infrastructure, HPC systems and related data center technologies.Strong track record of managing customer\-facing service operations, geographically distributed field teams, service partners and SLA\-driven environments.
   

  

**Preferred Skills**
 Exposure to warranty, AMC, RMA, spare\-parts management and hardware lifecycle services is highly desirable.

title: Lender Relationship Manager (Credit)
description:
**About Recur Club** 




  





 Recur Club is an AI\-native debt marketplace transforming how startups and SMEs access growth capital. Founded in 2021, we leverage real\-time business data and proprietary underwriting technology to connect high\-quality businesses with the right lenders\-enabling faster, smarter, and non\-dilutive financing.
 



  





 We raised $50M in Series A funding, led by Info Edge Ventures and Village Global, with participation from prominent global investors including Y Combinator, Titan Capital, and R8 Capital further accelerating our mission to make capital more accessible, faster, and more efficient for growing businesses.
 



  





 Powering this ecosystem is AICA (AI Credit Assistant) — our in\-house AI\-led infrastructure enabling faster underwriting, smarter risk assessment, and seamless credit decisioning at scale.
 



 We are also the force behind Bharat Ke Super Founders — India’s premier startup show, where bold
 



 founders pitch their ideas to top investors for real capital, with a ₹100 crore investment pool backing the next wave of entrepreneurs. With 2,000\+ businesses served and ₹3,000\+ crore in capital disbursed, we’re building the future of financing for growing companies.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




  




* As a Lender Relationships Manager (Credit), you will own lender engagement and case progression once a
* loan application has been logged in. While our operations team handles the login process, you will work
* directly with lender relationship managers, partnership teams, and credit decision\-makers to secure
* sanctions and drive disbursals.
* This is not a loan\-processing role. It requires someone who can understand a lender\&\#39;s credit concerns, build
* a credible case for reconsideration, negotiate justified deviations, and take ownership of moving
* transactions forward.



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  




* Drive sanctions and disbursals: Own post\-login case progression across lenders, proactively follow up with relevant stakeholders, resolve bottlenecks, and keep cases moving towards closure.
* Lead credit discussions and reconsiderations: Review rejected or stalled applications, understand the underlying credit concerns, and present supporting information and risk mitigants to seek reconsideration \- not simply resubmit the same file.
* Negotiate deviations and loan terms: Work with lender credit teams to secure justified policy deviations through the appropriate approvals. Negotiate competitive interest rates, suitable ticket sizes, and longer tenures based on the borrower;s profile.
* Own lender relationships across levels: Build and manage relationships with lender relationship managers, partnership teams, regional and zonal teams, and credit heads. Identify and engage the right decision\-makers to resolve case\-specific issues.
* Apply lender\-policy knowledge: Maintain a strong understanding of each lender\&\#39;s eligibility criteria, credit policies, negative lists, and serviceable pincodes. Use this knowledge to assess lender fit and identify potential approval challenges.
* Coordinate internal resolution: Work closely with sales and operations teams to address lender queries, obtain supporting information, and resolve requirements that could delay sanction or disbursal.
* Maintain accurate case tracking: Keep every live case updated with its current status, pending requirements, next steps, and expected timelines. Flag delays and risks proactively and communicate outcomes transparently.



  





**Required Experience and Skills** 




  




* 4\-8 years of relevant experience in business loans or unsecured business loans within an NBFC or fintech.
* Experience in credit management, lender or bank relations, or credit/backend leadership, with direct exposure to lender credit teams.
* Demonstrated experience in converting logged\-in applications into sanctions and disbursals.
* A track record of securing reconsideration of rejected cases through substantive credit discussions and supporting evidence.
* Strong knowledge of lender policies, negative lists, pincode eligibility, credit assessment criteria, and deviation requirements.
* The ability to assess borrower profiles, explain credit strengths and risks, and present appropriate mitigants.
* Strong negotiation, stakeholder management, follow\-through, and case\-tracking skills.



  





**What We Look For** 




  





 You take ownership beyond follow\-ups. You know when to challenge a rejection, when to escalate, and
 



 when a case is unlikely to proceed. You are persistent in pursuing viable cases while respecting lender credit requirements.
 



 You also communicate honestly. When a case slips or a commitment is at risk, you flag it early, explain the issue, and take responsibility for the next steps.
 



  





**Working Environment** 




 This is a fast\-paced, execution\-focused role where consistent effort is expected throughout the month \- not only at month\-end. You should be comfortable managing multiple live cases, navigating lender escalations, and being accountable for disbursals.

* Team\-Oriented Culture: Work in a collaborative, supportive environment with peers who are passionate about what they do.

title: Integrated Solutions Service Tech 4
description:
**Job Summary**
 The Service Manager \- Applied HVAC Chiller is responsible for leading service operations, maintenance programs, troubleshooting activities, and customer support for applied HVAC systems, including centrifugal, screw, scroll, absorption chillers, cooling towers, pumps, and associated controls. The role ensures high customer satisfaction, operational excellence, service revenue growth, and compliance with safety and quality standards.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Service Operations Management
   

  

* Lead and manage the service team responsible for installation, commissioning, preventive maintenance, breakdown support, and retrofit projects for HVAC chiller systems.
* Ensure timely resolution of customer complaints and critical equipment outages.
* Monitor service KPIs, response times, and customer service levels.
* Plan and allocate manpower, tools, and resources effectively.


 Technical Leadership
   

  

* Provide technical expertise for applied HVAC systems, including:
+ Centrifugal Chillers
+ Screw Chillers
+ Air\-Cooled Chillers
+ Water\-Cooled Chillers
+ Cooling Towers
+ Pumps and Hydronic Systems
+ Building Management Systems (BMS)
+ Chiller Plant Optimization Solutions

* Support root cause analysis for recurring equipment failures.
* Guide field engineers on complex troubleshooting and repair activities.


 Customer Relationship Management
   

  

* Develop and maintain strong relationships with key customers, consultants, facility managers, and contractors.
* Conduct regular customer reviews and service performance meetings.
* Identify opportunities for service contract renewals, upgrades, retrofits, and modernization projects.


 Business Growth \& Revenue Management
   

  

* Drive annual maintenance contract (AMC) and comprehensive maintenance contract (CMC) renewals.
* Achieve service revenue and profitability targets.
* Identify cross\-selling and upselling opportunities within the customer base.
* Support sales teams during technical discussions and service\-related proposals.


 Team Management
   

  

* Recruit, train, mentor, and develop service engineers and technicians.
* Conduct performance evaluations and skill development programs.
* Foster a culture of accountability, safety, and continuous improvement.


 Safety \& Compliance
   

  

* Ensure adherence to EHS standards and company safety policies.
* Conduct periodic safety audits and toolbox talks.
* Maintain compliance with local regulations, HVAC industry standards, and quality management systems.


 Reporting \& Documentation
   

  

* Monitor service reports, maintenance records, and customer documentation.
* Track service KPIs such as:
+ First\-time fix rate
+ Mean Time to Repair (MTTR)
+ Customer Satisfaction Score (CSAT)
+ Contract Renewal Rate
+ Service Revenue Achievement

* Prepare monthly operational and financial performance reports.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, HVAC Engineering, or related field.
* MBA is an added advantage.


**Experience**
* 8\-15 years of experience in HVAC service operations.
* Minimum 3\-5 years of experience in managing applied HVAC/chiller service teams.
* Experience with leading HVAC manufacturers such as Carrier, Trane, Johnson Controls, Daikin, York, Mitsubishi Electric, or equivalent is preferred.

title: Business Head  – Government Business & Strategic Projects
description:
**Business Head – Government Business \& Strategic Projects** 




  






 Company: Intozi Tech Pvt. Ltd.
 





 Location: Delhi NCR / Gurugram
 





 Experience: 20\+ Years
 





 Function: Government Business, Sales \& Strategic Projects
 




  





**Role Overview** 





 Intozi is looking for a senior leader with 20\+ years of experience in Government business and large technology/infrastructure projects to lead our Government vertical.
 





 This is not purely a sales or relationship\-management position. We are looking for someone who has handled the complete end\-to\-end lifecycle of large Government projects—from identifying and shaping an opportunity to tendering, order closure, project execution, acceptance, payment collection and long\-term account management.
 





 The candidate should also have a strong network and established relationships across Government departments, Smart Cities, Safe Cities, Police, Traffic Police, Municipal Corporations/MCD, Defence, PSUs, consultants and System Integrators.
 




  





**Key Areas of Experience** 





 The candidate should preferably have worked on large projects involving:
 



* Smart City \& Safe City
* CCTV Surveillance \& Video Analytics
* Integrated Command \& Control Centres (ICCC)
* Intelligent Traffic Management Systems (ITMS)
* Traffic Enforcement \& e\-Challan
* Police \& Homeland Security
* Municipal Corporations / MCD / Urban Local Bodies
* Defence \& Critical Infrastructure
* AI\-based Video Analytics
* Networking, Data Centre, Cloud and ICT infrastructure
* Large Government system\-integration projects



  





**End\-to\-End Project Ownership** 





 The candidate must have hands\-on experience across the complete Government project lifecycle, including:
 





 1\. Opportunity Identification \& Account Development
 





 Identify upcoming Government projects, budgets and opportunities well before the tender is published.
 





 Build relationships with Government decision\-makers, consultants, PMCs, Smart City SPVs, Police departments, municipal bodies and other stakeholders.
 





 2\. Requirement Understanding \& Solution Conceptualisation
 





 Understand the customer's operational requirements and work with technical teams to develop the overall solution architecture, scope, BoQ and implementation approach.
 





 3\. Pre\-RFP \& Tender Shaping
 





 Engage with customers, consultants and ecosystem partners during DPR, RFP and specification\-development stages.
 





 Understand technical specifications, eligibility criteria, PQ requirements, SLAs and commercial conditions.
 





 4\. Tender \& Bid Management
 





 Take ownership of bid strategy, including:
 



* Tender qualification and Go/No\-Go
* Technical and commercial bid strategy
* OEM and partner selection
* Consortium/JV strategy where required
* MAF and compliance requirements
* Technical specifications and BoQ
* Commercial costing
* Competition analysis
* Pre\-bid meetings and clarifications
* Technical presentations and demonstrations




 5\. Commercial Negotiation \& Order Closure
 





 Lead commercial negotiations with customers, SIs, partners and other stakeholders through final contract/PO closure.
 





 The candidate should understand payment terms, PBG/EMD, LD clauses, SLA penalties, warranty, AMC and other contractual obligations.
 





 6\. Project Execution \& Stakeholder Management
 





 Remain actively involved after order closure and work closely with project and technical teams for successful execution.
 





 Experience should include coordination with:
 



* Government customers
* System Integrators
* OEMs
* Consultants/PMCs
* Project teams
* Subcontractors
* Site teams and other stakeholders




 The candidate should understand implementation challenges associated with large multi\-location Government technology projects.
 





 7\. Testing, Acceptance \& Go\-Live
 





 Experience managing project milestones including:
 



* FAT
* Site deployment
* Integration
* UAT
* SAT
* Go\-Live
* Customer acceptance
* SLA compliance
* Project handover




 8\. Billing, Collection \& Project Closure
 





 The candidate should understand the commercial lifecycle beyond winning the order, including:
 



* Milestone billing
* Customer acceptance documentation
* Invoice approvals
* Payment follow\-up
* Receivables management
* PBG/retention release
* Project closure




 9\. AMC \& Account Expansion
 





 Develop the account beyond the initial project through AMC, additional licenses, capacity expansion, new use cases and additional projects.
 




  





**Candidate Profile** 





 We are specifically looking for someone who:
 



* Has 20\+ years of experience, preferably with significant Government/PSU exposure.
* Has personally managed large Government projects from opportunity identification through final payment/closure.
* Has strong relationships across Smart Cities, Safe Cities, Police, Traffic Police, Municipal Corporations/MCD, Defence and Government departments.
* Understands both sales and project execution, rather than having experience only in tender participation.
* Has experience working with large System Integrators, OEMs, EPC players, consultants and PMCs.
* Understands Government tendering, GeM, RFPs, PQ criteria, consortiums, contracts, PBG/EMD, SLAs and payment processes.
* Can engage with senior Government officials as well as technical/project teams.
* Has experience handling large\-value, multi\-stakeholder and multi\-location projects.
* Has strong commercial negotiation and stakeholder\-management capabilities.
* Can take complete revenue, order\-book, execution and collection responsibility for strategic Government accounts.



  





**Preferred Previous Roles** 





 Candidates may currently or previously have held positions such as:
 





 VP – Government Business
 





 Business Head – Government \& PSU
 





 Director – Government Business
 





 National Head – Government \& Smart Cities
 





 Business Head – Smart \& Safe Cities
 





 Government \& Defence Business Head
 





 Strategic Projects Head
 




  





**What We Are Looking For** 





 We are not looking only for a Government salesperson who can bring leads or participate in tenders.
 





 We are looking for a senior business leader who understands how a ₹10 Cr–₹100\+ Cr Government technology project moves through its entire lifecycle:
 





 Opportunity → Customer Engagement → Solution → DPR/RFP → Tender → Bid → Negotiation → PO/Contract → Execution → Integration → UAT/SAT → Go\-Live → Billing → Collection → AMC/Expansion
 





 The person should have the relationships to open doors, the commercial experience to win projects, and the execution understanding to take responsibility until successful project and commercial closure.

 At Orca, in the right environment and with the right team, talent has no boundaries. So if you're ready to join an amazing team of people who inspire each other every day, now is the time to find your place in our pod.

* **High\-growth:** 
 Over the past seven years, we've consistently achieved milestones that take other companies a decade or more. During this time, we've significantly grown our employee base, expanded our customer reach, and rapidly advanced our product capabilities.

 Our founders saw that traditional security didn't work for the cloud, so they set out to carve a new path. We're relentless pioneers who invented agentless technology and continue to be the most comprehensive and innovative cloud security company.

 With a valuation of $1\.8 billion, Orca is a cybersecurity unicorn dominating the cloud security space. We're backed by an impressive team of investors such as Capital G, ICONIQ, GGV, and SVCI, a syndicate of CISOs who invest their own money after conducting their due diligence.

 Our executives pride themselves on being accessible to everyone and believe in sharing knowledge with the employees. Each employee has a place in shaping the future of our industry.


**About the Role:**
 We are looking for a highly\-motivated, business\-focused, demonstrated team\-player to join us as a Customer Success Manager. In this role, you will be responsible for partnering with Customers to meet their security objectives, adopt our solution, understand the value of their investment, and expand their product footprint.

* Work with customer stakeholders, executive sponsors, and partners to drive business value and expansion. Build strong relationships within all levels of the organization from the practitioner level all the way up to the C\-suite. Proactively reach out to other BUs and executives to expand Orca's footprint.

* In your day to day with customers, you are the owner of the relationship, meaning that you understand your customer use cases, business outcomes, feature requests, escalation points, and key players at all times.


**What We're Looking For:**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience.
* 5\+ years experience in customer success, account management, engagement management, or pre\-sales roles related to driving positive customer outcomes and adoption.
* 5\+ years of experience working with Cloud Security, CyberSecurity, or SaaS products.
* Ability to communicate, operate and communicate in various organizational levels both internally and externally.
* Knowledge of modern Cloud Infrastructure providers such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud.
* Knowledge of and experience working in the Cloud Security industry.
* Familiarity with cloud technology and environments, along with the benefits and security challenges of working in the cloud.
* Thrive in a fast pace, dynamic environment.
* Excellent written, verbal communication skills, \& problem\-solving skills.
* A passion for creating and maintaining relationships, while working in a tight\-knit community culture.
* Ability to manage competing priorities.
* Passion for driving customer success that results in renewals, upside, and retention.
* AI proficiency.
* Ability to travel 30%

title: Partnerships Manager
description:
**About Atlys** 




 Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.
 



 Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.
 



 Atlys is changing that.
 



 We’re building an AI\-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we’ve processed visas for
 **1M\+ travellers across 127 countries** 
 . But we’re still early.
 



  





**The Role** 




 Our partners \- card networks, banks, airlines, travel platforms, fintechs \- are mostly many times our size. The job is to get a decision\-maker to take the call, then build a construct that works commercially for both sides.
 



 The second part is the hard part. A visa is a low\-frequency purchase. A partnership only works if you find the moment in the partner's own customer journey where we belong, and structure the economics so they have a reason to care.
 **There's no playbook.** 




  





**The Job** 



* **Own a portfolio of live partnerships** 
 \- deepen them and grow what they generate.
* **Take 4–5 new partnerships live every month** 
 , with most partnerships going from first conversation to live in about two weeks.
* **Run longer\-term partnerships** 
 that may span months, multiple geographies, and involve product, legal and procurement teams.
* **Write cold outreach that gets a reply from someone senior.**
* **Build the commercial construct** 
 , not just the relationship.
* **Drive go\-live across product, operations and legal** 
 to ensure partnerships move from conversation to execution.
* **Own the numbers on every relationship you hold** 
 and stay accountable for the outcomes of your partnerships.



  





**The Ideal Candidate** 




 You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:
 


* Have
 **0–2 years of experience** 
 . Exceptional fresh graduates are welcome.
* **Have no degree or institution filter** 
 \- we care about what you can do, not where you studied.
* **Write exceptionally well** 
 . This is the highest\-weighted skill for this role.
* Can reason from first principles and build a deal structure when there is no precedent to follow.
* Can be the most junior person in the room and still run the conversation confidently.
* Have strong commercial judgement and can think about what creates value for both Atlys and the partner.
* Are patient, input\-driven and comfortable with outcomes that can be lumpy while the work remains consistent every day.
* Take strong ownership and are comfortable building something without a predefined playbook.
* Communicate exceptionally well and can build relationships with senior decision\-makers.



*We hire exceptional people for their craft, not travel enthusiasts. We solve hard problems that happen to touch global travel and government infrastructure.* 




  





**What you can expect** 




 Atlys is built by a small team with outsized ambition, high ownership, and an obsession with doing great work.
 



 Here’s what you can expect:
 


* **Competitive compensation and equity** 
 so you participate in the value you help create.
* **Comprehensive health insurance** 
 covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check\-up on us.
* **A thoughtful leave policy** 
 with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off.
* **Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office** 
 , so the basics are taken care of while we build together.
* **Learning \& development credits** 
 to invest in courses, books, conferences and tools that help you get better at your craft.
* **Relocation support** 
 to make moving closer to the team as seamless as possible.
* **Great tools to do your best work** 
 , including high\-spec equipment and software.
* **An office designed for more than just work** 
 , with pickleball, table tennis, PlayStation, an arcade game room, an F1 simulator and even a full flight simulator.



  





 Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you’ll probably thrive here. If it doesn’t, it’s better to know that upfront.
 



  





*Come build the intelligence layer for global travel*

You will have the opportunity to gain a macro view of the firm’s financial activities and learn about complex legal entity structures and transactions while enjoying substantial interaction with other internal departments, including technical investing groups, corporate development, investor relations, legal and compliance, and software development groups.

title: AVP Premier Relationship Manager
description:
**Some Careers Open More Doors Than Others.**
 If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
   

  

**Wealth and Personal Banking (WPB)** 
 is our new global business combining Retail Banking and Wealth Management; and Global Private Banking, to become one of the world’s largest global wealth managers with USD1\.4 trillion in assets. Across Asia, where wealth pools are growing faster than in any other region, HSBC’s wealth revenues grew 12% in 2019 (year\-on\-year) to USD5\.7 billion. Our dedicated colleagues serve millions of customers worldwide across the entire spectrum of private wealth, ranging from personal banking individuals and families, through to business owners, investors and ultra\-high\-net\-worth individuals. We provide products and services such as bank accounts, credit cards, personal loans and mortgages, as well as asset management, insurance, wealth management and private banking that best suit our customers’ needs.
   

  

 We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join the WPB team.
   

  

**Role Purpose**
 The PRM \& SPRM role are client facing roles. Playing a integral part of HSBC RBWM flagship offering of ‘’Premier Banking’’ To grow and nurture HSBC Premier relationships (High Networth Individual) segment of the Personal Banking customer base) and achieve business targets as laid down and in accordance with the business plan To facilitate a single point of contact for all Premier customers, anticipate needs and provide required banking/financial advisory services. The jobholder to ensure that high quality customer service is provided to customers in line with Global Premier Service Standards. The identification of opportunities for wealth reviews and delivering wealth solutions as an adviser are amongst the key activities to achieve your goals as complied with local regulatory requirement.
   

  

 All this needs to be achieved by keeping the highest standards of integrity towards the bank and clients and the regulatory requirements.
   

  

**Principal Accountabilities**
**Impact on the Business / Function**
* Maximize profit and achievement of the growth of Premier clients portfolio
* Achieve agreed financial targets by development of existing and new relationships
* Build effective relationships with clients to retain and develop sustainable relationships
* Complete regular reviews with clients to understand their current and long term needs and advise them on the products and services that help them achieve their goals
* Effective use of tools and information to drive client service delivery and performance
* Maintain a minimum standard of qualifying Premier clients within portfolio as stated by Group
* Build a high personal and corporate profile in the community in which you are based. Develop network of Group and External professional contacts with the aim of introducing new business, enhancing technical knowledge and promoting the brand
* Monitor and act on daily sales activity management information and other internal information tools, using them to coach the wider Branch team in support of business goals
* Establish and agree client contact strategies in line with Group operating models
* Fully utilize and input to Client Relationship Management data, ensuring all client information is complete and kept up to date
* Demonstrate excellent understanding of client needs, recommend appropriate products and services, and achieve closure of sales


**Customers / Stakeholders**
* Own the client relationship with HSBC
* Maintain a deep understanding and technical knowledge of relevant products and services available from Group sources and elsewhere in order to provide the best solutions for clients and maximize revenues for Global Wealth and the Group
* Maintain highest standard of excellence in client service across the team and with individual portfolio \- Ongoing analysis of client portfolios through marketing of ideas and researching clients
* Monitor client satisfaction data implementing portfolio level improvements
* Work with the broader branch, support and direct teams to ensure achievement of the business performance measures by delivering differentiated products and services to the client


**Leadership \& Teamwork**
* To work as part of an integrated branch management team to ensure, standards and are met and operating models delivered
* Proactively support others through direct and indirect actions beyond activities particular to this role
* Collaborate with the wider team to deliver the Branch Performance measures and plan to support the multi\-channel client journey
* Establish and maintain strong working relationships with colleagues in the wider businesses and others as appropriate to service client needs


**Operational Effectiveness \& Control**
* Ensuring that sales \& operations are undertaken in accordance with HSBC Bank and Credit Policy Manual appropriate lending guidelines
* Agree and manage lending facilities within any agreed Approval Authority
* Manage operational risk, by using relevant data to identify risk situations and take any appropriate action to minimize loss
* Adhere to selling process and sales quality requirements
* Comply with the applicable laws, regulations, Group and local guidelines related to Sanctions and Anti\-Money Laundering policy of HSBC while undertaking various day to day operations
* Remain alert and promptly report to the Sanctions Officer/ Line manager ( As applicable and required by the Anti Money Laundering and sanction Policy) if a customer is found to be engaging in sanction evasion activities or violations of policy or any other related procedures.
* Understand the legal responsibility to be vigilant for unusual activity and reporting of the unusual activities
* Support the Country or Regional Offices / Investigations by providing additional information when required
* Responsible for attending and successfully completing the Sanctions related assigned training in the mandated timeframe
* Understanding the consequences of failing to attend or successfully complete the training as mandated
* Requesting additional training that you deem necessary or appropriate to perform your jobs through your entity manager
* Demonstrate an understanding of Politically Exposed People acceptance, prohibition, guidelines in order to ensure that is fully compliant
* Understand the relatively high reputational risk that arises from any perceived weaknesses in controls in respect of substantial cash deposits or withdrawals activity, wire transfer, monetary instruments and pouch and mail
* To be aware and Identify high risk indicators for various products and Services offered by example Cash, insurance, credit cards products etc
* Ensure that all records are obtained in respect of customers or New to bank customer for any products and services provided by HSBC are as per the process laid down.
* Must ensure that the prescribed process is being followed while dealing with non HSBC customers request for monetary instruments and wire transfers
* Ensure Adherence to the regulatory guidelines and internal policy of HSBC, which includes pouch and mail, monetary instruments, cash services and payment transparency Line of Business Procedures
* To be aware of AML risk posed by pouch and mail, Monetary instruments, cash services and wire transfer services and should undergo the mandatory training for the same
* Necessary remediation steps needs to be undertaken in case if there is any breach or non\-adherence to the policy laid down
* Must undertake necessary due diligence to ensure that the nature of the transaction is in sync with the customer profile , else raise it to line manager for further clarification
* The staff must be aware of the scope of services of various products and services that are offered and those which are prohibited because of the guidelines laid down in the line of Business procedures and must ensure the same is communicated to customer in a effective and polite manner
* Ensure adequate due diligence is undertaken by the Individual/team to ensure that the nature of the various transactions of wire transfer, cash services, monetary instruments are in sync with customer profile


**Major Challenges**
 The bank seeks to grow business through an efficient operation and the pursuit of providing clients with globally consistent experiences, excellent service, cross selling products and services appropriate to client needs in order to enhance that value. In the face of fierce competition in this segment the bank is seeking to grow the significance of this group in their contribution to our business.
   

  

 The Premier segment typically comprises clients with Total Relationship Balances of 25lakhs or more.
   

  

 We should also recognize our responsibility to the community in which we operate and improve the bank’s profile within those communities building economic value for the bank and its shareholders.
   

  

 The range of competitors and products has established an increased financial awareness in clients, creating demand for increased experience and skill at PRM level.
   

  

**A Premier Relationship Manager Requires The Following Key Attributes**
* Excellent sales and people management skills
* Client driven with a strong focus on quality of service
* Strong interpersonal communication skills
* A strong sense of ownership, responsibility and accountability
* An excellent understanding of financial planning, wealth management and understanding client need


 The jobholder forms an integral part of the wider HSBC management team. As part of this wider team the jobholder is expected to identify opportunities in their day to day activities that directly or indirectly contribute to the success of colleagues with differing responsibilities, particularly in other areas of HSBC such as Commercial and Private Bank.
   

  

**Role Context**
 The jobholder will own and manage a portfolio of clients with Total Relationship balance of 25 lacs or more
   

  

**The Jobholder Has Prime Responsibility For**
* Maximizing growth in their portfolio and achieving the plan/metrics
* Leading Premier activities to ensure opportunities are identified and client needs are met effectively, maximizing all available resources.
* Compliance with the relevant Group standards including regulatory organization as applied to the implementation of the strategy in their country


 Jobholder will hold Lending Approval authorities appropriate to their role.
   

  

 The job holder operates within the approved operating and strategic plan process to develop the business.
   

  

**Management of Risk**
* Adheres to processes and controls to identify and mitigate risks and ensures timely escalation of control issues and reputation risks.


**Observation of Internal Controls**
* Maintains HSBC internal control standards and addresses audit points and/or any issues raised by regulators in a timely manner.


**Role Dimensions**
* Portfolio Size of Total Relationship Value of 25 lakhs or more per customer
* Portfolio Size of Premier clients or number of relationships as dictated by market requirements
* Growth in Income, balances, clients volumes, number of clients, etc..


**Qualifications \- External**
**Knowledge \& Experience**
* Bachelor's degree with relevant experience
* Minimum of 5\-8 years of Relationship management work experience with high net worth clients.
* Evidence of strong sales results in insurance and investment products
* Relationship management experience with high net worth clients
* Strong technical skills in wealth management
* Strong communication, client focus and influencing skills
* Strong sales orientation, networking and portfolio management skills
* Sound knowledge of financial services products and services and the client relationship management system
* Understanding of business banking client segment and products and services
* Local regulatory \& license requirements \- job holder should possess valid licenses with accreditation on wealth management and qualification as required by country
* Clear view on how to work with Compliance, Credit \& Risk and Internal Control to ensure a balanced risk operating environment
* Able to communicate well in English and local languages


**Accreditations**
* IRDA (Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority) and AMFI (Association of Mutual Funds) certifications are mandatory


**Leadership Capabilities**
* Have an understanding of the immediate regional Global Wealth strategy and the ability to plan own activities accordingly
* Be ambitious about providing the highest standards of delivery to colleagues and clients
* Show ability to set stretch goals for self and the ability to deliver these with courage and tenacity
* Be authentic and show ability to engage with colleagues and clients to deliver at pace
* Make considered decisions that protect HSBC \& Global Wealth values, reputation and businesses


**Technical Capabilities**
**Global Wealth Management \- Relationship Manager Technical Capabilities**
**Client Skills**
* Client focus
* Sales orientation
* Portfolio management
* Communicating \& influencing


**Business Acumen**
* Marketplace knowledge
* Business understanding


**Solutions**
* Premier products and services
* HSBC services and propositions


**Processes**
* Risk and compliance
* Business processes
* Tools and systems


**Additional Information**
* Mandatory to successfully complete Anti\-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post\-course assessment as Required
* The global career band level will be offered depending on the selected candidate's skill and relevant experience
* Familiarity with AI\-enabled tools is an advantage.


 As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision\-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable.
   

  

 You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.
   

  

 HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.
   

  

 Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.
   

  

 Issued by The Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Limited, India

title: Named Account Manager - North
description:

We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real\-world problems with cutting\-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

 In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real\-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!
   

  

 We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real\-time problem\-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.
   

  

**Job Summary**
**Your Career**
 The Named Account Manager partners with our customers to secure their entire digital experience. You’re motivated by the desire to solve critical challenges facing our customer’s secure environment, so you’re prepared to connect them with a solution for every stage of threat prevention. This role is a significant driver of company revenue and growth. As an experienced and dynamic sales professional, you’re responsible for leading and driving sales engagements.
   

  

 Palo Alto Networks is leading the charge in platformization, offering best\-in\-breed solutions that enable customers to build a truly zero\-trust security architecture and navigate critical transformations. To ensure our sales team is equipped to guide customers, we've developed FLIGHT, an immersive onboarding program. Flight blends virtual and in\-person learning at our headquarters, where new sales hires will participate in dynamic cohorts, fully dedicated to their training without customer distractions. This focused approach ensures they emerge as well\-prepared sales professionals, ready to help customers leverage our comprehensive portfolio.
   

  

**Your Impact**
 Serve as the go\-to trusted advisor in Identity Security, influencing strategy and deal execution across complex enterprise opportunities.
   

  

* Partner with product, SE, and technical specialists to shape and deliver customer strategies \- driving adoption, modernisation and expansion of PANW Idira solutions.
* Translate complex Identity Security concepts into clear, business\-driven outcomes for executives, demonstrating technical relevance leveraging insights to influence CxO\-level decisions.
* Influence cross\-portfolio demand by identifying and articulating Identity Security needs across large complex portfolios.
* Stay on top of cybersecurity trends, competitor movements, and customer challenges to position PANW as a strategic partner.
* Your consultative selling experience will identify business challenges and create solutions for prospects and our customers
* Understand the competitive landscape and customer needs so you can effectively position the portfolio of Palo Alto Networks solutions
* Create clear goals and complete accurate forecasting through developing a detailed territory plan
* Leverage prospect stories to create a compelling value proposition with insights into value for that specific account
* Travel as necessary within your territory, and to company\-wide


**Qualifications**
****Your Experience****
* 10\+ years sales experience in Territory sales with a wide\-ranged network in Enterprise accounts in North India region
* Proven to consistently achieve sales goals and experience with closing larger deals
* Experience in direct customer selling role managing north region as terriorty
* Proven track record of successfully closing complex enterprise deals in cybersecurity or enterprise SaaS.
* Demonstrated ability to grow new logos and expand within existing customers.
* Outcome\-oriented with strong commercial judgment.
* Technical aptitude for understanding how technology products and solutions solve business problems
* Identifies problems, reviews data, determines the root causes, and provides scalable solutions
* Cultivate relationships with our channel partners to bring channel\-centric go\-to\-market approach for our customers
* Demonstrates in depth knowledge of the full sales cycle and the ability to follow a structured sales process
* Commercial curiosity and the ability to uncover customer pain points through active listening.
* Ability to take a holistic approach to problem solving by understanding the bigger picture, and considering complex interrelationships and outcomes
* Excellent time management skills, and work with high levels of autonomy and self\-direction


**Our Commitment**
 We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
   

  

 We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.
   

  

 Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

 Who we are
   

  

 A healthier future drives us to innovate.  Let’s build a healthier future, together.
