This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
   

  

 The Position
   

  

**Patient Journey Partner\- Ophthalmology**
**Location: Delhi**
**The Position**
 A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.
   

  

 We are seeking candidates to join our team as Patient Journey Partner In this role, you will have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on patient care by connecting Roche’s capabilities and resources to co\-create solutions with key stakeholders involved in the patient journey. Your role is multifaceted, addressing diverse patient journey needs such as accelerating access to treatments, streamlining decision making. This role is locally embedded in the ecosystem, it is an integrated role, functionally agnostic, (i.e. it does not fit into the traditional concepts of Commercial/Sales or Medical Affairs). The PJP focuses on the importance of bringing the outside in, working with partners to uncover all potential opportunities to transform outcomes for patients, faster. They also bring the inside out, to bring Roche expertise, science and knowledge to the ecosystem.
   

  

**Your Opportunity**
* You will be responsible for end to end management of Top Therapy Area Expert relations and legitimate needs through right identification of challenges, belief, motivators
* You will be a one point of contact for top accounts of the state. You will be creating and executing strategies for the top public \& private accounts, aligning with and support state teams for effective execution of the state strategies, so as to serve and maximize patients with Roche Innovations
* You will be building relationship with key decision makers in the account Identifying and resolving business issues in top accounts and Implement strategies and drive results for enhancing access to Roche innovations
* You will be leading collaboration in field through co\-creation of solutions for key accounts


**Who You Are**
* You are someone who has a relevant graduate/ post graduate degree in Science. From an experience standpoint having more than 8 years’ experience with 4\+ years in Ophthalmology
* You must exhibit strong collaboration and networking skills, process orientation and alliance management


 Who we are
   

  

 A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life\-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
   

  

 Let’s build a healthier future, together.
   

  

**Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**

title: Marketplace Vendor Growth Manager
description:
**About the job** 




**Position:** 
 Marketplace \& Vendor Growth Manager
 



**Department:** 
 Marketplace / Business Growth
 



**Experience:** 
 2–6 years
 



**Location:** 
 Netaji Subhash Place, Pitampura, Delhi
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



  





**About Nutristar** 




 Nutristar is a growing Health \& Wellness marketplace focused on bringing trusted brands and products across nutrition, supplements, fitness, wellness and healthy living to consumers through a strong digital\-first platform.
 



 We are looking for a
 **smart, driven and highly commercially oriented Marketplace \& Vendor Growth Manager** 
 who can take ownership of building and scaling Nutristar’s brand/vendor ecosystem.
 



 This is not a routine vendor\-management role. We are looking for someone who can
 **identify opportunities, onboard the right brands, negotiate commercially, analyse data and continuously find ways to grow marketplace GMV, revenue and profitability.** 




 Key Responsibilities
 



**Brand \& Vendor Acquisition** 




 ·       Identify and build a pipeline of high\-potential health, wellness, nutrition and lifestyle brands.
 



 ·       Reach out to brands, pitch Nutristar and drive the complete onboarding process.
 



 ·       Build strong relationships with founders, business heads and brand teams.
 



 ·       Negotiate commercials, margins, commissions, payment terms, exclusivity and promotional participation.
 



 ·       Continuously expand the marketplace with relevant, differentiated and high\-potential brands.
 



**Marketplace Growth** 




 ·       Own marketplace GMV, revenue, assortment and brand growth.
 



 ·       Identify categories, brands and products with high growth potential.
 



 ·       Analyse sales, conversion, margins, AOV, repeat purchases, inventory and product performance.
 



 ·       Develop strategies to increase sales of existing brands and improve overall marketplace productivity.
 



 ·       Identify gaps in assortment and proactively bring in products/brands to fill them.
 



**Business \& Analytics** 




 ·       Strongly data\-driven decision making — numbers should be a core part of the role.
 



 ·       Track marketplace KPIs and create actionable insights from data.
 



 ·       Analyse brand\-wise, category\-wise and SKU\-wise performance.
 



 ·       Identify underperforming vendors/products and develop corrective action plans.
 



 ·       Evaluate commercial viability and ROI of new brands and partnerships.
 



 ·       Prepare regular marketplace performance reports and growth plans.
 



**Merchandising \& Commercials** 




 ·       Work closely with the marketing and e\-commerce teams on promotions, campaigns and merchandising.
 



 ·       Ensure the right products and brands receive the right visibility.
 



 ·       Drive vendor participation in Nutristar campaigns and promotional events.
 



 ·       Optimise assortment, pricing, offers and product visibility to maximise marketplace performance.
 



 ·       Work towards improving marketplace margins and contribution.
 



**Cross\-functional Ownership** 




 ·       Coordinate with operations, finance, marketing, customer support and technology teams for smooth vendor operations.
 



 ·       Ensure brands are onboarded quickly and efficiently.
 



 ·       Resolve commercial, operational and performance\-related issues with vendors.
 



 ·       Continuously improve marketplace processes and vendor experience.
 



 What We’re Looking For
 



 ·       
 **2–6 years of experience** 
 in marketplace, e\-commerce, category management, business development, key accounts, vendor management or a similar commercial role.
 



 ·       Experience with marketplaces/e\-commerce is strongly preferred.
 



 ·       Experience in
 **health, wellness, nutrition, beauty, FMCG or D2C** 
 would be an advantage.
 



 ·       Strong analytical and Excel/Google Sheets skills.
 



 ·       Excellent understanding of
 **GMV, revenue, margins, contribution, conversion, AOV, sell\-through and marketplace metrics.** 




 ·       Strong negotiation and communication skills.
 



 ·       High business acumen — able to understand
 **what will actually make money** 
 , not just execute tasks.
 



 ·       Extremely proactive, fast\-moving and comfortable working independently.
 



 ·       Ability to look at numbers, identify a problem/opportunity and
 **take action without being spoon\-fed.** 




 ·       Strong ownership mentality and willingness to work in a fast\-growing environment.
 



 ·       Excellent presentation and relationship\-building skills.
 



 The Ideal Candidate
 



 We are looking for someone who is:
 



**Smart \| Fast \| Analytical \| Commercially Sharp \| Entrepreneurial \| Proactive \| Excellent Communicator** 




 Someone who doesn't just say
 *“the numbers are down”* 
 — but asks
 **why, figures it out, proposes a solution and gets it implemented.** 




**Preferred:** 
 Female candidates with strong communication, commercial maturity and a high\-energy, entrepreneurial approach are encouraged to apply.
 



 What You’ll Get
 



 ·       Significant ownership of Nutristar’s marketplace growth.
 



 ·       Direct exposure to brands, founders and business leaders.
 



 ·       Opportunity to build and shape the marketplace from an early/growth stage.
 



 ·       High degree of autonomy and responsibility.
 



 ·       Fast\-paced, entrepreneurial working environment.
 



 ·       Performance\-driven growth opportunities.

title: Head – School Partnerships & Growth
description:
HEAD – SALES
   

  

**Department:** 
 Sales \& Business Development
   

  

**Location:** 
 Delhi NCR / Pan India
   

  

**Reports To:** 
 CEO / Business Leadership
   

  

**About EdTerra**
 EdTerra Edventures is a leading experiential learning and educational travel company that designs and delivers immersive learning journeys for school students across India and international destinations.
   

  

 We partner with schools to create meaningful experiences that combine travel, learning, culture, adventure and real\-world exposure.
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 We are looking for a
 **Head – Sales** 
 to lead EdTerra's sales function and drive the next phase of revenue growth.
   

  

 This is a
 **business leadership role** 
 with end\-to\-end ownership of the sales engine—from market strategy and school acquisition to key account growth, sales\-team performance, forecasting and revenue delivery.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will be a commercially strong, data\-driven and inspiring sales leader who can build scalable sales systems while personally driving strategic relationships with large schools and institutional partners.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities1\. Revenue \& Business Growth
   

  

* Own the overall sales revenue, growth and commercial performance for the business.
* Develop and execute the annual and quarterly sales strategy in line with organizational objectives.
* Translate business targets into territory, segment, product and team\-level targets.
* Identify new revenue opportunities across geographies, school segments and products.
* Drive both new business acquisition and growth of existing accounts.
* Develop strategies to increase customer lifetime value, repeat business and wallet share.
* School \& Institutional Partnerships
* Build and maintain strong relationships with school management, principals, trustees, coordinators and other key decision\-makers.
* Lead negotiations and closures for strategic/high\-value school accounts.
* Develop long\-term partnerships with schools and educational institutions.
* Create account\-development plans for key schools.
* Drive cross\-selling and up\-selling across EdTerra's domestic, international and experiential learning programmes.
* Act as the senior escalation point for strategic clients.
* Sales Team Leadership
* Lead and mentor the complete sales organization across regions/functions.
* Define team structures, roles, territories, targets and performance expectations.
* Recruit, coach and develop high\-performing sales managers and sales professionals.
* Establish a strong culture of ownership, accountability and performance.
* Conduct structured weekly, monthly and quarterly business reviews.
* Identify capability gaps and implement targeted coaching and development plans.
* Build a strong succession pipeline for critical sales positions.
* Sales Process \& Performance Management
* Build a predictable and scalable sales process from lead generation → qualification → meetings → proposals → negotiation → closure → repeat business.
* Establish clear sales KPIs and performance dashboards.
* Monitor conversion ratios at every stage of the funnel.
* Improve sales productivity and reduce sales\-cycle time.
* Ensure disciplined CRM usage and accurate pipeline management.
* Establish mechanisms for identifying and resolving pipeline bottlenecks.
* Forecasting \& Business Intelligence
* Own the monthly and quarterly sales forecast.
* Maintain strong visibility on pipeline value, probability and expected closures.
* Develop accurate revenue projections based on historical performance and current pipeline.
* Use sales data to identify trends, risks and opportunities.
* Present actionable sales insights and recommendations to the leadership team.
* Develop territory\-wise and account\-wise performance dashboards.
* Market Expansion
* Identify and evaluate new cities, regions and school segments for expansion.
* Analyse competitor positioning, pricing, offerings and market trends.
* Develop go\-to\-market strategies for new products and markets.
* Identify emerging opportunities within the education and experiential\-learning ecosystem.
* Work with the leadership team to evaluate strategic partnerships and new business channels.
* Key Account Growth \& Retention
* Build a structured Key Account Management framework.
* Develop annual growth plans for strategic schools.
* Drive repeat journeys, renewals and increased engagement with existing schools.
* Monitor account health, satisfaction and revenue potential.
* Ensure high\-value clients receive proactive relationship management.
* Work with Operations and Customer Experience teams to resolve critical client concerns.
* Commercial \& Margin Ownership
* Balance revenue growth with profitability and contribution margins.
* Participate in pricing and commercial strategy.
* Establish appropriate discounting and negotiation frameworks.
* Monitor deal economics and commercial effectiveness.
* Work closely with Finance to improve collection efficiency and reduce outstanding receivables.
* Ensure sales commitments remain commercially and operationally viable.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration


**Work Closely With**
* Marketing – lead generation, campaigns and brand positioning
* Product – product development, pricing and market fit
* Operations – delivery feasibility and execution
* Finance – pricing, margins, collections and commercial controls
* HR – manpower planning, hiring and capability development
* Customer Experience – client satisfaction and retention


 Ensure seamless alignment between
 **what is sold, what is promised and what is delivered** 
 .
   

  

 Success in the First 12 Months
   

  

**The Successful Candidate Will Be Expected To**
* Deliver agreed annual revenue and growth targets.
* Build a predictable and healthy sales pipeline.
* Improve sales conversion and sales productivity.
* Strengthen the key\-school account portfolio.
* Increase repeat business and customer retention.
* Build a high\-performing and accountable sales leadership team.
* Improve forecast accuracy.
* Establish standardized sales processes and performance dashboards.
* Identify and successfully penetrate new markets.
* Improve revenue quality and contribution margins.


 Key Performance Indicators
   

  

**Business**
* Revenue Achievement %
* YoY Revenue Growth
* Gross Contribution / Margin
* New Revenue


**Acquisition**
* New Schools Acquired
* New Revenue from New Accounts
* Conversion Rate
* Average Deal Value


**Retention \& Growth**
* Repeat Revenue %
* School Retention
* Key Account Growth
* Revenue per Strategic Account


**Sales Productivity**
* Pipeline Coverage
* Sales Cycle
* Lead\-to\-Meeting Conversion
* Meeting\-to\-Closure Conversion
* Individual \& Team Productivity


**Forecasting**
* Forecast Accuracy
* Pipeline Health
* Closure Predictability


**People**
* Team Target Achievement
* Sales Attrition
* Manager Productivity
* Internal Talent Development


 Candidate ProfileExperience
   

  

* 10–15\+ years of progressive experience in B2B / institutional / consultative sales.
* 4\+ years in a senior sales leadership role managing sizeable sales teams.
* Proven experience owning significant revenue targets.
* Experience managing multi\-city or multi\-region sales operations preferred.
* Strong experience in relationship\-led businesses such as education, EdTech, travel, hospitality, SaaS, media or other B2B services will be advantageous.


 Education
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in any relevant discipline.
* MBA/PGDM in Sales, Marketing, Business Management or a related field preferred.


 Core Competencies
   

  

* Strategic Sales Leadership
* Revenue \& P\&L Orientation
* B2B / Institutional Sales
* Enterprise/Key Account Management
* Negotiation \& Commercial Acumen
* Sales Forecasting
* CRM \& Sales Analytics
* Market Expansion
* Team Building \& Leadership
* Coaching \& Performance Management
* Cross\-functional Collaboration
* Executive Communication


 Leadership Traits We Value
   

  

**We Are Looking For Someone Who**
* Thinks like a business owner, not just a salesperson.
* Is highly accountable for outcomes.
* Can operate strategically while remaining close to the ground.
* Uses data to make decisions.
* Builds strong, long\-term relationships.
* Can challenge existing processes and create better systems.
* Develops people rather than simply managing them.
* Is comfortable working in a fast\-paced, growth\-oriented environment.
* Has the energy and maturity to represent EdTerra with senior school stakeholders.


 Why Join EdTerra?
   

  

 At EdTerra, sales is not simply about selling a product.
   

  

 It is about building long\-term partnerships with schools and helping create experiences that can have a lasting impact on students.
   

  

 As Head – Sales, you will have the opportunity to
 **shape the sales organization, influence business strategy, build a high\-performing team and directly contribute to EdTerra's next phase of growth.**
 Skills: leadership,sales,management

title: Ecommerce Manager
description:
**Job Title: E\-Commerce \& Marketplace Growth Manager** 




  





 We are looking for a highly driven and commercially minded
 **E\-Commerce \& Marketplace Growth Manager** 
 to take ownership of our online sales channels and drive growth across marketplaces, our website, and other digital commerce platforms.
 



  





 This is not a purely operational role. We are looking for someone who can think like a business owner—someone who can identify opportunities, improve sales, optimise profitability, study competitors, develop new product ideas, and build new revenue channels.
 



  





 The ideal candidate will manage and grow our presence across platforms such as
 **Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, our own website, and other relevant marketplaces and aggregator portals** 
 .
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Marketplace Management \& Growth** 



* Manage and grow sales across Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra and other relevant e\-commerce and aggregator platforms.
* Create, optimise and manage product listings, including titles, descriptions, keywords, images and product information.
* Monitor product performance and identify opportunities to improve sales and visibility.
* Plan and execute pricing, discounts, offers, bundles and promotional campaigns.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure inventory availability and minimise stock\-outs.
* Monitor product ratings, reviews, returns and customer feedback.
* Identify underperforming SKUs and develop strategies to improve or discontinue them.
* Identify high\-performing products and opportunities to scale them.



  





**2\. Website Sales \& Digital Commerce Growth** 



* Drive sales and growth through the company website.
* Identify opportunities to improve website conversion rates and customer experience.
* Create product bundles, combo offers, trial packs, family packs, premium packs and other initiatives to increase average order value.
* Develop cross\-selling and upselling opportunities across the product portfolio.
* Work with internal and external teams to improve product pages, offers and customer journeys.
* Develop strategies to increase repeat purchases and customer retention.



  





**3\. Customer Feedback, Testimonials \& Retention** 



* Develop and manage a structured process for collecting customer feedback.
* Conduct customer calls to understand product experience and satisfaction.
* Identify satisfied customers and collect written and video testimonials.
* Build a strong repository of customer reviews, testimonials and user\-generated content for use across digital platforms.
* Follow up with customers to encourage repeat purchases and referrals.
* Analyse customer complaints and feedback to identify opportunities for product and service improvement.



  





**4\. Competitor Research \& Pricing Strategy** 



* Continuously monitor competitors, their products, pricing, offers and promotions.
* Conduct regular market research to identify trending products and emerging opportunities.
* Identify products that competitors are selling successfully and evaluate whether they can be developed, manufactured or sourced in\-house.
* Work with internal teams to identify opportunities for competitive pricing while maintaining healthy margins.
* Prepare regular competitor and market intelligence reports for management.



  





**5\. New Product \& Revenue Opportunities** 



* Identify new product categories and opportunities that can generate additional revenue.
* Research products currently performing well in the market and assess their commercial potential.
* Identify opportunities to manufacture, source or develop products at competitive pricing.
* Work with internal teams to develop new SKUs, variants, sizes, bundles and product extensions.
* Explore high\-margin complementary products and add\-on opportunities.
* Present commercially viable new product and revenue ideas to management on a regular basis.



  





**6\. New Digital Sales Channels** 



* Identify and onboard relevant e\-commerce platforms, aggregator portals and other digital sales channels.
* Explore opportunities for affiliate marketing, referral programs and micro\-influencer partnerships.
* Develop strategies to increase direct\-to\-consumer sales and reduce dependency on any single marketplace.
* Identify potential opportunities in bulk orders, corporate sales, gifting and B2B partnerships where relevant.



  





**7\. Sales, Data \& Profitability** 



* Track daily, weekly and monthly sales performance across all channels.
* Monitor profitability at a product and channel level.
* Analyse the impact of discounts, commissions, returns and promotional campaigns on margins.
* Identify opportunities to reduce costs and improve profitability.
* Prepare regular MIS and growth reports for management.
* Take ownership of assigned revenue and growth targets.



  





**What We Are Looking For** 



* Proven experience in managing e\-commerce marketplaces such as Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra or similar platforms.
* Strong understanding of online product listings, pricing, promotions and marketplace operations.
* Commercial mindset with the ability to identify new sales and revenue opportunities.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to understand product profitability, margins and pricing.
* Experience with website sales and D2C e\-commerce will be an advantage.
* Comfortable speaking with customers and conducting feedback or testimonial calls.
* Ability to conduct competitor and market research.
* Highly proactive, organised and result\-oriented.
* Strong communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of business outcomes.



  





**Preferred Profile** 




 We would prefer someone who:
 


* Has hands\-on experience managing multiple e\-commerce platforms.
* Understands both
 **sales growth and profitability** 
 .
* Can independently identify problems and propose solutions.
* Is comfortable working in a fast\-paced and entrepreneurial environment.
* Has a strong interest in consumer products, digital commerce and new product development.
* Thinks beyond day\-to\-day operations and actively looks for new business opportunities.

**Consulting –** 
**Manager\- Customer Service Transformation and AI**
**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 The
 **Manager – Customer Service Transformation and AI** 
 will drive AI\-led service transformation initiatives within the Customer practice, combining service strategy, AI solution design, process improvement, and delivery excellence. The role will support clients in reimagining service journeys, contact centre operations, field service, and knowledge\-enabled support models through responsible use of AI, automation, analytics, and workflow orchestration. You will work with senior stakeholders to identify transformation opportunities, shape practical roadmaps, and deliver measurable improvements in customer experience, service productivity, resolution quality, and operating efficiency.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Business Development \& Market Leadership**
* Support the development of AI\-led service transformation opportunities across advisory and implementation engagements, contributing to pipeline growth and client relationship expansion.
* Contribute to proposals, RFP responses, solution narratives, and executive presentations focused on service modernization, AI adoption, and customer operations improvement.
* Support GTM development for AI\-enabled service offerings across sectors, including contact center transformation, intelligent case management, field service optimization, and digital self\-service.
* Develop reusable assets, accelerators, and points of view on AI\-led service transformation, customer operations, and service experience modernization.
* Stay current on emerging service models, AI adoption patterns, automation trends, and customer expectations that may influence client service transformation priorities.


**Client Engagement \& Delivery**
* Lead workstreams within service transformation programs from current\-state assessment through roadmap design, implementation planning, and adoption support.
* Assess service processes, customer journeys, operating models, channel mix, agent workflows, knowledge management practices, and performance metrics to identify improvement opportunities.

title: Area Manager - Coronary Vascular

 Coronary Vascular is focused on advancing therapies that support the treatment of coronary artery disease, hypertension, and related cardiovascular conditions. The team partners closely with interventional cardiologists, catheterisation laboratory teams, and healthcare institutions to expand access to coronary vascular technologies and drive clinical adoption across diverse care settings.
   

  

 This position supports the Delhi NCR, Muradabad, and Muzaffarnagar territory and is based in Gurugram. The role operates in a remote field\-based sales model with regular customer visits across the assigned geography. Approximately 30% travel is required to support customer engagement, clinical case coverage, training activities, distributor management, and business development initiatives.

* Provide procedural support and clinical expertise during coronary interventions and other relevant cardiovascular procedures.
* Partner with distributors and channel partners to maintain product availability, optimise secondary sales, and support commercial growth initiatives.
* Analyse market dynamics, customer needs, and competitive activity to identify growth opportunities and support business planning.
* Deliver product education, post\-sales training, and customer support programmes to enhance clinical confidence and adoption.
* Maintain accurate sales forecasts, customer records, and business reports to support territory management and operational effectiveness.

* Experience managing multi\-level stakeholder relationships across hospitals, healthcare systems, and clinical departments.
* Clinical experience within an interventional suite, hospital environment, emergency medical services, or procedural care setting.
* Experience delivering clinician training, product education, or post\-sales support programmes.
* Knowledge of coronary vascular technologies and cardiovascular disease treatment pathways.

**Title And Summary**
 Specialist – Regional Customer Success Operations, Services

 Services within Mastercard is responsible for acquiring, engaging, and retaining customers by managing fraud and risk, enhancing cybersecurity, and improving the digital payments experience. We provide value\-added services and leverage expertise, data\-driven insights, and execution.
   

  

 Our Regional Customer Success teams play a crucial role in ensuring our customers achieve their desired outcomes while maximizing the value of our products and services. As advocates for customer experience, this team is accountable for a strong onboarding experience, providing ongoing strategic support, and fostering long\-term relationships.
   

  

 They work collaboratively with cross\-functional teams to address customer needs, gather feedback on product improvements, develop tailored strategies that enhance customer satisfaction and retention, build customer advocacy to support our B2B marketing campaigns and create leads for value expansion for our Business Development teams. By focusing on proactive engagement and personalized service with our customers, the team is dedicated to driving customer value and contributing to the overall growth of the organization.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Are you passionate about building scalable operations that empower customer\-facing teams to deliver exceptional value? Join Mastercard’s Services Customer Success team as a Customer Success Operations Sr. Specialist. In this role, you’ll help shape the future of customer success operations across a global, growing organization. You’ll support the development of tools, processes, and insights that enable our teams to deliver consistent, high\-impact customer experiences.
   

  

 The Sr. Specialist of Services Global Customer Success Operations reports to the Customer Success Lead within the APAC and will support in the development and delivery of strategic priorities for Customer Success within Mastercard Services. The primary focus of the role will be to support best\-in\-class Customer Success Operations Mastercard Services’ business. You will be working within the region to enable common operating models and playbooks across CS teams, including developing flexible frameworks for key tools and customer segmentation strategies, creating a strong measurement framework of metrics and KPIs to evaluate performance and provide actionable insights to our colleagues.
   

  

**Responsibilities Will Include**
 Strategy \& Process Design
   

  

* Support the execution of the Customer Success (CS) Operations roadmap for Mastercard Services
* Partner with leadership to define and evolve playbooks, risk detection, segmentation strategies, and engagement frameworks; with clear tracking of outcomes
* Support the implementation of scalable CS practices across diverse product lines and customer segments


 Systems \& Tools
   

  

* Support the configuration and adoption of Gainsight and other systems in the CS tech stack (e.g., Salesforce, Tableau)

* Collaborate with internal teams to train, support adoption, and collect feedback to prioritize enhancements and ensure seamless user experiences


 Metrics \& Insights
   

  

* Track KPIs to measure CS performance and customer health
* Build dashboards and reports for stakeholders ranging from executives to front\-line teams
* Track leading indicators of positive outcomes and perform analysis to identify trends that enable action


 Collaboration \& Enablement
   

  

* Work with Product, Value Enablement, and Program teams to embed CS metrics into broader business KPIs
* Champion CS best practices across the organization and support change management initiatives
* Conduct research on emerging trends (e.g., AI in CS) to inform strategy and innovation


**All About You**
* Customer Success Operations or related role experience with an understanding of CS strategy and execution
* Proven ability to design scalable processes and translate technical capabilities into business value
* Strong verbal and written communication skills to effectively convey the vision, goals, and progress of customer success initiatives
* Ability to work globally and cross\-functionally; persuasive through influence with stakeholders to gain buy\-in for customer success strategies
* Strong analytical skills with experience in reporting, dashboards, and performance metrics to drive customer success outcomes
* Experience integrating with other technology solutions in the customer success space (e.g. Gainsight, Salesforce, Tableau, etc.) to create seamless and easy\-to\-use processes
* Takes a high degree of ownership, optimizing processes to enhance efficiency and fostering a culture of excellence and continuous improvement
* Experience in managing organizational changes, training colleagues, and ensuring adoption of new processes and technologies including AI
* Passionate about delivering for our customers; always exhibits \& champions a customer\-centric mentality
* Experience with Gainsight or similar CS platforms, a plus


**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

 We're looking for an ownership\-driven customer success manager who can run the back bone of customer experience for Oyela. You'll be the single point of accountability and own Oyela's entire post\-purchase customer experience — the team, the process and the promise. You will lead 10 support agents and 2–4 escalation leads, and be the single owner of what a customer hears from us, how fast they hear it, and what happens inside the company when they raise an issue. description:
**We help the world run better**
 At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed.
   

  

**Who You’ll Become**
 The Account Executive's primary responsibilities include prospecting, qualifying, selling, and closing new business to existing and net new customers. The Account Executive empowers our customers to achieve their full potential by understanding their strategy, unique business goals, and desired outcomes, thereby driving cloud revenue growth through leading dedicated sales efforts to help customers solve their business challenges by positioning value through our solutions.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 As an Account Executive within the SAP Next Gen \- Academy for Customer Success, you will be responsible for the following:
   

  

* Successfully complete a 10\-month learn\-apply program, which includes classroom phases and field phases with your sales team, that enhances your support in the role and is a critical customer\-facing function within our Customer Success Board Area.
* Immerse yourself in multi\-dimensional, experiential learning focusing on digital transformation, global intelligence, human skills, business and technology acumen, solution/industry knowledge, and strategy/tools/process.
* Learn how to drive value across the customer lifecycle through solution adoption and ongoing renewals that foster account expansion.
* Receive onboarding in your local market with on\-the\-job training and mentoring by a Senior Account Executive in the field. You will be able to work both behind the scenes and directly with customers.


 The program will enrich your knowledge of SAP and the Customer Success board area and give you professional experience so that you can be ready to serve our customers. We offer full\-time employment from day one with practical learning applications for your role. Upon successful completion of the program, you will move into a direct customer\-facing sales role in your market and continue to receive mentoring and coaching support to accelerate your growth.
   

  

**Sales Focus Areas**
* SAP Customer Experience (CX) \- Knowledge of e\-commerce, sales, customer service, and marketing processes.


**What You Bring**
* 1–3 years of professional experience in a quota\-carrying sales environment in a technology company OR in a role with significant exposure to business processes.
* Experience generating opportunities, qualifying leads, and managing sales pipelines across a defined territory with a proven track record of building customer relationships and articulating value propositions.
* A cooperative and productive approach to working relationships, internally and externally.
* A strong ability to quickly learn new concepts, adapt to changing environments, and apply knowledge to deliver results.
* An understanding of AI fundamentals, uses, and ethics, to identify business problems solvable with AI.
* Strong Business Acumen, including demonstrated knowledge of business processes and/or industries.
* Proficiency in English to engage with our global network.
* AI focus areas: (AI Adoption Mindset, Agentic AI Day\-to Day Practice, and Context Engineering)
* A curious and agile mindset, with a passion for learning and the resilience to adapt in a fast\-paced, evolving environment.
* Strong problem\-solving, project management, and creative thinking skills, with the ability to collaborate across teams and communicate ideas clearly and effectively.
* Emotional intelligence and cultural awareness that support inclusive teamwork and thoughtful stakeholder engagement.
* A growing foundation in business acumen and emerging technologies—especially artificial intelligence—paired with a results\-oriented approach and the courage to take initiative.


**The SAP Academy for Customer Success is a global development program designed for talent who are early in their career.**
**About SAP Academy For Customer Success**
 The SAP Academy for Customer Success offers a three\-year journey that drives accountability and enhances productivity. It enables graduates to make a quick impact in customer\-facing roles while fostering career longevity and leadership potential.
   

  

 Join us for a unique opportunity to build a global network, collaborate with customers to solve real business challenges, and gain hands\-on experience with world\-class cloud solutions — all while learning in a dynamic environment and earning competitive pay and benefits.
   

  

**\#SAPAcademyforCustomerSuccess** 
**\#SAPNextGen**
**SAP Next Gen** 
 is our global experience for students and early talent (0–3 years of professional work experience). Being a part of the Next Gen community provides access to a supportive global network, tailored development opportunities, and the ability to contribute to high\-impact projects across the business.
   

  

 SAP’s employees across different regions are enabled to do their best job with the right mix of office and remote work according to country\-specific guidelines and regulations. In general, our
 **hybrid work setup** 
 consists of
 **three days a week in the office or on\-site with customers or partners.**
 We are planning a practical and immersive portion of our program, which will likely involve participants spending
 **four (4\) weeks, spread across two trips, in San Ramon, California.** 
 This experience is designed to provide unparalleled hands\-on learning and networking opportunities.
   

  

 During intensive phases of the program, it is critical that all participants are fully engaged and present to ensure maximum learning and success. As such,
 **vacation will not be approved during some critical times of the program.**
**Bring out your best**
 SAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. Originally known for leadership in enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, SAP has evolved to become a market leader in end\-to\-end business application software and related services for database, analytics, intelligent technologies, and experience management. As a cloud company with two hundred million users and more than one hundred thousand employees worldwide, we are purpose\-driven and future\-focused, with a highly collaborative team ethic and commitment to personal development. Whether connecting global industries, people, or platforms, we help ensure every challenge gets the solution it deserves. At SAP, you can bring out your best.
   

  

**We win with inclusion**
 SAP’s culture of inclusion, focus on health and well\-being, and flexible working models help ensure that everyone – regardless of background – feels included and can run at their best. At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. We ultimately believe in unleashing all talent and creating a better world.
   

  

 SAP is committed to the values of Equal Employment Opportunity and provides accessibility accommodations to applicants with physical and/or mental disabilities. If you are interested in applying for employment with SAP and are in need of accommodation or special assistance to navigate our website or to complete your application, please send an e\-mail with your request to Recruiting Operations Team: Careers@sap.com.
   

  

 For SAP employees: Only permanent roles are eligible for the SAP Employee Referral Program, according to the eligibility rules set in the SAP Referral Policy. Specific conditions may apply for roles in Vocational Training.
   

  

 Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their age, race, religion, national origin, ethnicity, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, et al), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, or disability, in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local legal requirements.

title: Customer Success Representative
description:
Customer Success Representative
 



  





 Company: 360 SaaS Pty Ltd — Portal 360 
 



 Location: Gurugram, Haryana, India 
 



 Hours: Sydney business hours, 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM AEST/AEDT (approx. 4:30 AM – 1:30 PM IST, shifting by an hour with Australian daylight saving)
 



 Reports to: Founder \& CEO (Sydney) 
 



 Type: Full\-time
 



  





 About Portal 360
 



  





 Portal 360 is an AI\-powered, all\-in\-one practice management platform built for Australian accountants, bookkeepers, fractional CFOs, and advisory firms. We're helping firms consolidate their tech stack, automate the busywork, and focus on client advisory. As we scale, our customers' success is the engine of our growth — and this role sits right at the heart of it.
 



  





 The role is based out of our Gurugram office and works Sydney hours, giving you full overlap with our Australian customers and leadership team.
 



  





 The role
 



  





 The Customer Success Representative is the human face of Portal 360 for our prospects and customers. You'll run product demos, guide new firms through onboarding and configuration, and be the trusted point of contact who makes sure customers get real value from the platform — not just access to it. Your job is to make Portal 360 firms thrive: adopted, configured well, and quietly wondering how they ever ran their practice without us.
 



  





 This is a people\-first role. You'll spend your days on calls, in inboxes, and on Microsoft Teams with firm owners, partners, and their teams — so how you communicate matters as much as what you know.
 



  





 What you'll do
 



  





 Demos \& pre\-sale
 



  





 Run tailored product demos over Microsoft Teams for prospective Australian firms, translating features into outcomes that matter to accountants, bookkeepers, and advisors.
 



  





 Follow up with leads after demos and trials — answering questions, addressing objections, and moving them toward a confident decision.
 



  





 Feed prospect questions and objections back to the product and marketing teams so we keep sharpening the pitch.
 



  





 Onboarding \& configuration
 



  





 Own the end\-to\-end onboarding experience for new customers — from kickoff call to go\-live.
 



  





 Configure Portal 360 to match each firm's workflow: entities, users and permissions, integrations, templates, automations, and branding.
 



  





 Import and validate client data, ensuring a clean start on the platform.
 



  





 Train customer teams through live Teams sessions, recorded walkthroughs, and written playbooks.
 



  





 Ongoing customer success
 



  





 Be the named contact for a portfolio of firms — proactively checking in, monitoring adoption, and surfacing features they're not yet using.
 



  





 Run periodic health checks and business reviews with customers, tying platform usage to their practice goals.
 



  





 Handle day\-to\-day questions and light support triage, escalating technical issues to the product team with clear reproduction steps.
 



  





 Identify expansion opportunities (extra seats, additional modules, group entities) and pass warm leads through.
 



  





 Feedback loop
 



  





 Capture customer feedback, feature requests, and friction points systematically, and advocate for them internally.
 



  





 Contribute to help documentation, onboarding templates, and demo scripts as the product evolves.
 



  





 What we're looking for
 



  





 2\+ years in a customer success, account management, onboarding, or SaaS support role — ideally with SMB or professional services customers, and ideally serving international (AU, UK, or US) clients.
 



  





 Exceptional spoken and written English — clear, warm, professional, with a neutral accent that Australian customers find easy to follow.
 



  





 An outstanding communicator who can hold a room on a demo, defuse a frustrated email, and translate technical detail into plain language for a non\-technical audience.
 



  





 A natural ability to connect with people — you build rapport quickly, listen more than you talk, and customers genuinely enjoy hearing from you. This is the difference between a good CSR and a great one, and we hire hard for it.
 



  





 Comfortable running demos and speaking with confidence to firm owners, partners, and operations managers on the other side of the world.
 



  





 Confident using Microsoft 365 day to day — Teams, Outlook, SharePoint, and the wider Microsoft ecosystem.
 



  





 Strong understanding of how an accounting, bookkeeping, or advisory firm actually operates day to day (or the curiosity and aptitude to learn fast).
 



  





 Genuinely technical enough to configure a modern SaaS platform: integrations, permissions, automations, data imports.
 



  





 Organised and self\-directed; comfortable owning a customer portfolio without hand\-holding.
 



  





 Willing and able to work Sydney business hours from Gurugram, five days a week, with a reliable early\-morning start. This isn't a rotational shift — it's a consistent schedule.
 



  





 Based in Gurugram or able to relocate; comfortable working from our office.
 



  





 Nice to have
 



  





 Prior experience serving Australian customers, or working on Australian time zones.
 



  





 Experience with practice management, workflow, or CRM platforms (Karbon, Ignition, XPM, FYI, Xero Practice Manager, Canopy, etc.).
 



  





 Background working in or with an accounting or bookkeeping firm.
 



  





 Experience contributing to help centres, onboarding playbooks, or product training material.
 



  





 Why Portal 360
 



  





 Ground\-floor role in a fast\-growing Australian SaaS company with a clear market and real customers.
 



  





 Direct access to the founder and product team — your feedback shapes what gets built.
 



  





 Genuine ownership of the customer experience end to end, not a narrow slice of it.
 



  





 Part of a broader group of companies (with operations across Sydney and Gurugram) and real room to grow your career.

title: Renewal Manager

**Description**
**What We’re Looking For:**
 In this role, you'll play a vital part in our organization, with your primary focus being to secure on\-time renewal revenue and secure revenue across our Indian portfolio. You will work closely with our extended account teams to maximize the value provided to the customer, ensuring our long\-term partnership, while also owning the discipline that keeps renewals and payments on track across a broad client base spanning SMB, Mid\-Market, and Enterprise. Meltwater offers an environment where you'll be surrounded by talented coworkers at the cutting edge of AI Martech, working across one of our most diverse account portfolios in the region.
   

  

**What You’ll Do:**
* Lead efforts to ensure on\-time renewal revenue across your India portfolio, spanning SMB, Mid\-Market, and Enterprise accounts, collaborating closely with our account teams.
* Own collections end\-to\-end on your book chasing overdue invoices, resolving billing disputes, and working with Finance/AR to keep outstanding balances current and DSO in check.
* Handle the hard conversations at volume. This portfolio involves customers weighing competitors, raising product or billing concerns, or facing payment delays you'll be the person having those conversations, calmly and commercially, week in and week out.
* Proactively cultivate relationships with customers, ensuring their awareness of our product offerings and adoption of their current package.
* Identify upcoming renewals and maintain accurate account and payment status data within the CRM system.
* Develop quotes, manage administrative tasks, and oversee the execution of renewal contracts.
* Flag payment risk and churn risk early, and build recovery plans before either becomes a surprise.
* Feed what you're hearing from customers competitor moves, product gaps, payment friction back to leadership to shape our approach to the market.
* Run an accurate forecast which identifies outlook, best case scenarios, and risk, including collections status as part of that picture


**What You’ll Bring:**
* A Bachelor's degree or higher is required for this role.
* 3\+ years in sales, renewals, or customer success, ideally SaaS including experience retaining customers in competitive or at\-risk situations.
* Direct experience with collections or accounts receivable follow\-up comfortable owning difficult payment conversations, not just renewal conversations.
* Comfort managing a varied portfolio across SMB, Mid\-Market, and Enterprise accounts, each with different stakeholders and different risk profiles.
* Exceptional organisational skills, emphasizing data accuracy and meticulous attention to detail.
* Customer\-centric mindset, adept at engaging with customers and effectively addressing their concerns.
* A proactive approach to identifying and flagging upcoming renewals, payment risk, and potential issues before they arise.
* Strong communication skills to articulate renewal options clearly and collaborate effectively with Account Managers and customer success colleagues.
* Commercial acumen to spot risk early and ensure our services are evolving alongside our clients.

title: Key Account Manager - Modern Trade Offline
description:
About the Role
 



 We are looking for a results\-driven
 **Key Accounts Manager – Modern Trade** 
 to manage and grow relationships with leading offline modern trade retailers and key retail chains.
 



 The role will be responsible for driving revenue, distribution, visibility, and profitability across assigned key accounts. The ideal candidate should have strong experience in modern trade, excellent account\-management skills, and a deep understanding of retail operations, trade promotions, negotiations, and in\-store execution.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



 1\. Key Account Management
 


* Own and manage relationships with assigned modern trade accounts and retail chains.
* Develop strong relationships with buyers, category managers, commercial teams, and store\-level stakeholders.
* Act as the primary point of contact for key accounts and ensure smooth business operations.
* Conduct regular business reviews and develop joint business plans with key customers.



 2\. Sales \& Revenue Growth
 


* Deliver monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets across assigned accounts.
* Develop account\-wise growth strategies based on sales trends, category performance, and market opportunities.
* Drive volume, value, assortment, distribution, and share of shelf within key accounts.
* Identify opportunities for new product launches, range expansion, and incremental business.



 3\. Trade Promotion \& Commercial Management
 


* Plan and execute account\-specific promotions, visibility programs, and consumer offers.
* Negotiate trade margins, promotional investments, listing fees, visibility spends, and other commercial terms.
* Ensure optimum ROI on trade spends and promotional investments.
* Track schemes, discounts, claims, and deductions and ensure timely resolution.



 4\. Distribution \& In\-Store Execution
 


* Ensure effective product availability across stores and improve distribution and fill rates.
* Drive secondary sales and monitor store\-level execution.
* Work closely with merchandising and sales teams to ensure visibility, planogram compliance, and optimal shelf placement.
* Monitor stock levels and identify risks of stock\-outs, excess inventory, or slow\-moving SKUs.



 5\. Business Analytics \& Reporting
 


* Analyse account\-wise sales, SKU performance, inventory, distribution, promotion effectiveness, and profitability.
* Prepare regular sales forecasts and ensure accurate demand planning.
* Track key account KPIs and identify corrective actions to improve performance.
* Provide market and competitor insights to the sales and category teams.



 6\. Cross\-Functional Collaboration
 


* Work closely with Supply Chain, Finance, Marketing, Category, and Operations teams to ensure seamless account management.
* Coordinate new product launches, replenishment, promotions, and commercial activities.
* Resolve operational issues related to orders, invoicing, supply, claims, and payments.



  





 Required Skills \& Experience
 


* 3–8 years of experience in
 **Modern Trade / Key Account Management preferably** 
 beauty, personal care or retail.
* Strong experience managing large offline retail chains and modern trade accounts.
* Proven track record of achieving sales and revenue targets.
* Strong negotiation, commercial, and relationship\-management skills.
* Good understanding of modern trade processes, retail margins, promotions, listing, visibility, and account profitability.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Good communication and presentation skills.
* Willingness to travel for account meetings and market/store visits.

 • Lead the Customer Experience function by creating a seamless, convenient, and rewarding shopping journey across all customer touchpoints.
   

 • Drive a customer\-first culture by using customer insights, feedback, and market trends to improve the overall shopping experience and influence business decisions.
   

 • Ensure operational excellence by identifying and removing barriers that impact customers throughout their buying, checkout, payment, and after\-sales journey.
   

 • Support commercial priorities and collaborate with cross\-functional teams to maximize sales, customer satisfaction, and business performance.
   

 • Oversee the IKEA Food business, ensuring commercial success while maintaining the highest standards of food safety, Swedishness, and regulatory compliance.
   

 • Develop and implement customer service, food business, and operational action plans aligned with local, national, and global business objectives.
   

 • Ensure compliance with IKEA policies, legal requirements, food safety regulations, and operational best practices.
   

 • Build strong partnerships with internal stakeholders and external partners to enhance operational efficiency and protect the IKEA culture and values.
   

 • Plan and manage departmental resources, budgets, and investments to achieve operational and financial targets.
   

 • Lead, coach, and develop team members by setting clear goals, supporting individual growth, and building a strong succession pipeline.
   

 • Analyze customer, consumer, brand, and operational data to provide recommendations that improve customer experience and business performance.
   

 • Champion continuous improvement initiatives and contribute to the implementation of customer experience and retail food strategies across the store.
   

 • Ensure a safe environment for customers and co\-workers by promoting safety, security, and compliance across all operations.
   

 • Foster collaboration across commercial and support functions to deliver integrated and consistent customer experience across all channels.
   

  

**TOGETHER AS A TEAM** 
  

 At IKEA it’s all about our customers, and in Customer Relations we build and retain long\-lasting relationships with new and existing customers in a multichannel retail environment. We’re a diverse team that work together to ensure a positive and joyful experience for all IKEA visitors and customers: we set up services, gather feedback and make things right! Our modus operandi is to connect to people by listening to their personal needs and to create genuine interactions. We’re a bunch of people who are truly passionate about people!
   

  

 Studies show that members of underrepresented communities don't apply for jobs unless they're 100% "qualified". If this is part of the reason you hesitate to apply, we would like you to reconsider and give it a chance. Maybe your profile fits our needs much better than you think. We look forward to receiving your application. From: "Why Women Don't Apply for Jobs Unless They're 100% Qualified" by Tara Sophia Mohr, August 2014"

 The role will involve managing a team of Account Managers, building strong relationships with key stakeholders, identifying business opportunities within existing accounts, and ensuring achievement of revenue and account management objectives.
 



 The ideal candidate should have strong
 **people management, stakeholder management, client relationship, commercial, and business growth skills** 
 , along with the ability to manage multiple strategic accounts.

 Team Management \& Leadership
 


* Lead, mentor, and manage a team of Account Managers/Key Account Managers.

* Conduct regular performance reviews, coaching, and development discussions.

* Drive revenue growth from existing accounts through cross\-sell, upsell, and account expansion opportunities.

* Work closely with Sales, Operations, Product, and other internal teams to achieve business objectives.
* Track revenue, account profitability, renewals, and other key business metrics.
* Develop and execute strategies to improve account penetration and wallet share.



  





**Cross\-functional Collaboration:** 



* Collaborate with internal stakeholders to ensure seamless delivery of client commitments.
* Work with Operations and Service teams to maintain agreed service standards.
* Partner with Finance for billing, collections, and commercial\-related matters.
* Coordinate with Product/Technology teams to address client requirements and improve solutions.
* Ensure alignment between client expectations and internal delivery capabilities.



  





**Desired Candidate Profile** 



* Bachelor's degree in any discipline; MBA/PGDM preferred.
* **8–12 years of experience in Account Management, Key Account Management, Client Servicing, Relationship Management, or Business Development.**
* Prior experience of
 **managing and leading a team** 
 is mandatory.
* Strong experience managing enterprise/key accounts and senior stakeholders.
* Demonstrated track record of achieving revenue, retention, and account growth targets.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
* Strong commercial acumen with the ability to understand revenue, margins, and profitability.
* Strong problem\-solving and escalation\-management skills.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, target\-driven environment.
* Strong analytical and decision\-making capabilities.
* Experience working cross\-functionally with Sales, Operations, Finance, Product, and other teams.

description:

 **Hyderabad, Telangana, India; Bengaluru, Karnataka, India; Gurugram, Haryana, India** 
 .
 **Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

**Preferred qualifications:**
* Experience integrating content strategy with product and engineering roadmaps, with the ability to influence others and to communicate and collaborate well with cross\-functional teams.
* Google ads product knowledge and experience using AI\-powered tools.
* Strong understanding of content strategy, knowledge management principles, and data analysis.
* Demonstrate a deep understanding of Generative AI guardrails, including identifying and mitigating risks like hallucinations or grounding issues, to ensure that AI\-driven solutions provide a consistently reliable, accurate, and high\-quality experience for Google’s users and partners.
* Ability to independently manage multiple, time\-sensitive project schedules and identify and mitigate risks.


**About The Job**
 Businesses of all shapes and sizes rely on Google’s unparalleled advertising solutions to help them grow in today's dynamic marketing environment. You bring a passion for sales, knowledge of online media, and commitment to maximize customer success. You act like an owner, move with velocity through change, finding innovative and strategic ways to consistently deliver extraordinary and incremental outcomes for both Google and your customers. You build trusted relationships with customers, uncovering their business needs and translating them into powerful solutions to achieve their most ambitious goals. You achieve as a team with sellers, shape the future of advertising in the AI\-era, and make a real impact on the millions of companies and billions of users that trust Google with their most important goals.
   

  

 gTech Ads GCS Customer Experience organization is a customer centric, solution\-generating team that helps our advertisers and sales teams make the most out of our products. Our core operations primarily follow standard business hours.
   

  

 As a Solutions Consultant, you will have deep product knowledge, provide high quality customer experience and own customer solutioning. You will focus on managing troubleshooting tasks and provide resolution to issues. You will also be responsible for liaising with internal/external stakeholders to provide communication on customer issues and questions.
   

  

 However, ensuring a seamless, customer experience across our global markets is central to our strategy. To solve for critical customer needs and to optimize resolution velocity, you may occasionally be aligned to alternative shifts schedules on a rotational basis. To fully support your well\-being, Google provides support for any non\-standard operational shifts.
   

  

 Google creates products and services that make the world a better place, and gTech’s role is to help bring them to life. Our teams of trusted advisors support customers globally. Our solutions are rooted in our technical skill, product expertise, and a thorough understanding of our customers’ complex needs. Whether the answer is a bespoke solution to solve a unique problem, or a new tool that can scale across Google, everything we do aims to ensure our customers benefit from the full potential of Google products.
   

  

 To learn more about gTech, check out our video .
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Own the content strategy within a specific product area, aligning content development with product roadmaps and prioritizing high\-impact launches. Turn business goals into content solutions.
* Drive the success of AI\-powered solutions by mapping user intent to specific content solutions. You will translate business requirements into precise AI instructions (prompts) and monitor model behavior to ensure responses are grounded in fact and aligned with Ads product logic.
* Develop and refresh high\-quality content solutions (text, video, interactive AI) for top user issues and customer journeys within your priority product areas.
* Analyze metrics and customer insights across product and support surfaces to deliver strategy recommendations tailored to your product area.
* Engage with cross\-functional forums (Product Circles, CoE, etc.) to integrate content strategy with broader product\-specific initiatives.
